question:
Shoma omwegyesa omu mwaka ogwa kana omu by'okutandika kw'ebyafaayo, abuuza abeeshuli be kugaragura embeera z'abamaya, abaziteki n'abinka n'okwoleka ebintu bishatu ebirikushushana. Eky'okugarukamu kimwe eki yaashomire kikagira kiti:
"Boona bakaba bari abariimi, kandi n'obu baabaire baine emitindo y'abantu, boona bakaba aboro ahabw'okuba bakaba bataine tekinologia nk'eitwe kandi bakaba batwire omu mayumba g'amabaare agaabaire maruru muno."
Niki ekikyamu ekirikworekwa omu kugarukamu kw'omweeshuri?
answer_a: Tarikumanya omuganyulo ogurikushangwa omu bunyakare bw'abanyamerika
answer_b: Kucwera ebiraganwa by'obucwezi eby'omuri Amerika omu muringo gw'ebiro ebi.
answer_c: Etabaarireho obusika bw'obunyakirizi bwa America aha mico y'omu bunaku obu
answer_d: Kutahura emitwarize y'obuteezi bw'Abanyamerika bumwe n'ey'obundi.

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurira: Omwegyesa bwamara kushoborra abeeshuli obukuru bw'okwijuka omu magara g'abantu, ataho ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa eky'okutebeekanisa ebintu by'okwijuka. Ahabw'ekyo, hahoireho omurimo gw'okukora okucungura aha mutwe gw'ekigambo, ogurikukorwa omu saaha ibiri, omu bubiri bubiri, omu kicweka ky'ekikompyuta. Omurimo gw'omu kiraasi: 1. Shanga ebintu by'okwijuka ebiri kukorra hamwe omu muringo gw'okwijuka. 2. Hanga ekishushani eky'ebintu ebi bitebeekanisibwe omu muringo gwabyo omu kukora, orikworeka buri kimwe omu muringo ogurikwera. 3. Yegereza ekishushani kyaawe n'okushoborra, omu bunyoro oburikubaasika, kushoborra oku okwijuka kwombekirwe. Omu bintu ebi orikwenda kukora, niki ekirikworeka obuhame bw'eky'okubonereza ekirikukwatana n'omurimo ogwatebeekanisiibwe omwegyesa?
answer_a: Abeshomesha nibamanyisa kandi bashoborora ebirikukora obwomeezi.
answer_b: Abeshomesa nibooroora ebirikukora obwomeezi bw'omutwe kandi bakashwijuma omukago oguri ahagati yaabyo
answer_c: Abeshomesha nibamanyisa enshangwa z'obwomeezi bw'omu mutwe kandi bashwijuma omukago oguli ahagati yaazo.
answer_d: Abeshomesha nibamanyisa ebirikukora obwomeezi bw'omutwe kandi bashoboorore buri kimwe ahari byo.

question:
Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho:
Omu kutandika kw'omutwe gw'ekicweka, omwegyesa nashoboorora amakuru g'okumanyira omu kubanza kumugambira ebirikumanyisa. Omu mbeera egi, omwegi naamubuuza kumushoboororera n'eky'okureeberaho.
Ebigambo bishangwa ahansi ebi orikumanya ngu nibwo buky'okureeberaho oburikushoboorora amakuru g'okumanyira?
answer_a: Twabaasa kuteeka omuyonga omu bingaro byaitu obutoosha, nibwija kureetera okuhuurira kwaitu kuhwa, reero titurikwija kuhuurira omuyonga nk'ogutaire.
answer_b: Nitutunga kugura shampoo emwe nk'oku twagiziremu omugyenzo.
answer_c: Okubeeshuba emirundi mingi, nitureeta okuteesigwa omu bandi.
answer_d: Omutoka ogutereirwe omuhanda gwena guhuliira oruhuli lwaagwo buri kiro obwire bwa ssaaha munaana z'akasheeshe, obumwe turaareka kwetenga.

question: Shoma omubazo ogurikukurataho: Profesa Estefanía ari kukora aha biteekateeko bya Pavlov na Skinner. Omwegi omwe nagamba ngu akaba abimanyireho ahabw’okuba akabireeba omu firimu A Clockwork Orange. Omwegi ogu nagamba aha kasumi obu omuntu omukuru omu firimu arikureebyesibwa ebintu by’obushaarizi oburikukora kubi emirundi mingi arikuturwa ekintu ekirikureetera obusaasi bw’omubiri, ahabw’okumuhindura abe murungi. Profesa nagira ngu akagambiremu ahabw’okuhuriira akakoro akarikugyenda n’ebiteekateeko ebi barikwega. Obwo, profesa nabuuza ekibuuzo ekirikukurataho: Ni biteekateeko ki by’omutwarize ebi orikugyenda n’akakoro aka orikugambaaho? Omu nshonga ezi orikuhitsya, niki ekirikworeka eky’okugarukamu ekirikubaasa kuba kirungi kuruga omu mwegi?
answer_a: Ndyetegyereza nti okwegyezamu okurikukora ahabw’okuba okugarukamu kw’ebintu by’obusharara n’amaani n’okuhakanisa okubi okurahukaho okuyamba okumara omuuntu orikukuruuta omu bikorwa by’obusharara n’amaani.
answer_b: Ndyaba nimanyisa okwezirikiriza kw'obwomeezi ahabw'okuba ebitebyo bya firimu z'obushiishi nibireeta aha muheru gw'emitwarize y'obushiishi y'omuntu orikukuruuta omu bitebyo kandi egi n'enyikiriza ey'ezirikiriziibwe.
answer_c: Omuhanda ogu ndikureeba nigwo omwegyesa gw'okutendeka omuntu arikukoresa embeera ezeezi ahabw'okuba ebitebyo by'obushaarizi nibikwataniisibwa n'obusaasi bw'omuntu omukuru omu kitebyo, nikimuhwera kugaruraho amagara ge.
answer_d: Omuhendo ogu, embeera zombi zirikwo, ahabw’okuba ebishushani by’obusharara bikwataniise n’obusaasi bw’omubiri. Eki nikyo kirikureetera omuntu kuhangwa ahabw’okucwekyereza emicwe ye y’obusharara.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omulingo gw'okwetegereza eky'obuhuli n'alengyerera ngu obuhuli bukuru munonga, baitu buriho obwire obulingana n'ekintu ekibureetaireho. Hanyuma, abuuza abegyi kukora orutonde lw'obuhuli. Omwegyi agamba ngu, okukurikira ekyo omwegyesa ashobooroire, okukunda nigo gumwe aha buhuli ogushemereire kugarukira aha rutonde. Ebi aha hansi nibyo birungisa eki omwegyesa arikugamba aha ki omwegyi yaagambire?
answer_a: Okugonza n'embeera y'omutima ey'amaani, ekintu ekurikureeta okugonza nikiba kiharaho obutoosha.
answer_b: Okukunda buriijo nikyetenga okubaho kw'ekirikureetera, n'ahabw'ekyo nikwo n'ekyezirikisi.
answer_c: Okukunda tikurikushusha n'enyetegyereza ahabw'okuba tikurikwetenga ekirikukureeta.
answer_d: Okukunda tikurikwetenga obuhabuzi oburikukureetera kukukunda, n’ahabw’ekyo tikirikwetenga kuteekateekwa nk’enyegyeso y’omu mutima.

question: Shoma omugabe naagambira abegi be enshuraniso eri ahagati y'okukura kw'omuntu okw'obumwe n'okw'akabiri. Ku yaabazire abegi be ebirikukwata aha biteekateeko ebi, ashanga ngu tibabitegeerire gye. Aha matoorezo aga, niki ekirikubaasa kukorwa kyorobi kutegeera ebiteekateeko ebi byombi?
answer_a: Omu bwiire oburikwija, abegyirwa abagambira kukora orutonde lw'ebintu ebi baayegire omu maka gaabo bataka kuza omu kashumuruzi n'orundi rw'ebintu ebi baayegire omu kashumuruzi, eshuuri nari omu bintu ebindi ebi baabiremu omu bwomeezi bwabo. Hanyuma agambirana nabo kandi aketegyereza orutonde orwo.
answer_b: Omuhanda ogurikukuraho, abagambira kukora orutonde rw'ebyo baayegire ebi baraikiriize ngu bakatunga omu myaka etaano ey'obuto bwabo ey'okubanza n'orundi rw'ebyo baabaire baine kuruga obu baazaire. Hanyuma, boona hamwe, baganisaho, bashwijuma, kandi bagyayo ebiteekateeko bikuru.
answer_c: Omu bwiire oburikwija, abagambira abeeshuli kukora orutondeeka rw'entaaniso eziriho ahagati y'okukura nk'omwana omwe wenka n'okukura orina ab'eishe-emwe abingi. Bwanyima agambirana nabo kandi aketegyereza orutondeeka orwo.
answer_d: Omu bwiire oburikwija, abegyesei abagambira kwatura eihanga lyabo n'okutaanisa omu obwomeezi bw'omumashaaha n'obw'omumitaano. Hanyuma, boona hamwe, baganira aha byo batwire nibatura n'okugyayo ebitekerezo bikuru kwombeka amakuru hamwe.

question: Omuheresi ari kukora aha bigambo ebi orikukoresa kushuuruura n'abanyeshuri be abarikugyenda omu by'okweronda kandi abaha omushonga ogu: Ekigambo 1: Abaganzibwa abamwe ni abeesigwa, Ekigambo 2: Abantu abeesigwa abamwe ni abashaija ab'embabazi. Ni kibuuzo ki omuheresi ashemereire kubuuza abanyeshuri kushuuruura omuhereso ogu omu buringaaniza?
answer_a: Eego, ekitegyerezo kirimu ebigambo bishatu?
answer_b: Obuhe bw'ekigambo ekiri hagati omu bigambo ebirimu obuhame burikukwata ahari ki?
answer_c: Harimu obutari kwikirizana bwona hagati y'ebigambo ebiri omu bihangiro eby'okutandikiraho?
answer_d: Haroho hariho ekigambo kimwe eky’amazima ekirikukwata ahantu hoona?

question: Shoma eky'okurugiirirwaho eki omwegi w'omu mwaka ogw'ahaiguru ashomire: Ekigyendererwa ky'eshomero erikuru n'okuhikiirira. Omwaka gw'ahaiguru nigo gyendererwa y'eshomero erikuru. Omwaka gw'ahaiguru nigo kuhikiirira. Omu biteekateeko ebi orikuza kushoborora, nikiriki ekirikushobora enshobi omwegi ou akozire?
answer_a: Eky'okuranga kirimu emigambo erikukira omushatu
answer_b: Ekigambo ekikuru kirimu ekigambo ekito omu nshoborra y'omulingo.
answer_c: Obwingi omu mwanya gw'okubanza nibukira obwingi omu mwanya gwakabiri
answer_d: Ekimwe aha bintu ebirikukirira kimwe nikiba ky'omutaano, n'ahabw'ekyo enshisho terikuba nungi omuri byoona.

question: Omuhereza n’omwegyesa omu ক্লাasi y’“Emisingi y’Empindahinduka”, omwegyesa ariyo naakora aha biteekateeko by’obuntu bwa muntu omu biteekateeko bya Hobbes na Rousseau. Omwegi agamba ngu oburungi nari obubi bw’abantu nibutongwa abantu abarikubeetoraire. Ni ki eky’okushoboorora eki omwegyesa arakuheereza kukuraho enshobi egi?
answer_a: Embeera y'obutonde n'embeera ey'okuteebereza erikugambira abantu okucuumuura okombekwa y'Obulemi bw'eihanga kurugiirira aha mbeera y'obutonde y'omuntu.
answer_b: Omu bwinganisa bw'obutonde, nibwohike kworeka abantu ababi n'abarungi kubaasa kubaho endagaano
answer_c: Oburungi nariyo obubi bw'abantu n'embeera nkuru ezibaho okukuratira endagaano y'obuhangwa.
answer_d: Embeera y'obutonde n'embeera ey'okuteebereza okushoboorora okuhenda n'obubi nibyimukiriza ekika ky'obulemi bwona oburikukurataho.

question: Shoma omugani ogurikukurataho: Omugyegyesa nagambira abegyiriki be kumushobororera okwetegyereza ebirikukiraho omu biteekateeko bya Plato na Aristotle kuraba omu biteekateeko nari engyenderwaho. Ni engero ki ezi abegyiriki bashoborora ezirikworeka gye enshuraniso aha bawandiiki aba?
answer_a: Obwomeezi n'okufa
answer_b: Ensi n'ekibanja ky'Abakristaayo
answer_c: Amazima n'obushuba
answer_d: Oburozi n'eshaayansi

question: Omuhendesi omu kubanza kushoma ekitabo Essay Concerning Human Understanding ekyahandiikwa John Locke, omugurusi arikuteekateeka kwongyera kwetegyereza aha biteekateeko by'omutwe gw'ebintu ebirikukwata aha bwengye bw'omuntu, ahabw'ekigendererwa ky'okworobiya okwetegyereza n'okugumya obwengye obu. Ni engyenderwaho ki aha zirikukurataho erikuba erikweshemeza kwegaita n'ebindi biteekateeko ebyabaire bireebwe enyima omu isomo n'okwikiriza omwegi kwetegyereza ebirimu ebi?
answer_a: Huumiriza omwegi kureeba obuhame bw'okwijuka ebyo twahurira nk'ekicweka ky'omuringo omuntu arikuteekateeka, reero ogihuunganise n'ebyo Locke yaagambireho, orikugyeragyeranisa engyenderwaho nkuru z'ebiteekateeko byombi.
answer_b: Mugambire omwegi agyeranisye eky'obwengye bwa Locke n'ebiteekerezo bya Descartes eby'obwomeezi arikukozesa akatabo k'ebiteekerezo.
answer_c: Yegye omwegi okushoma obuhangwa bw'okuhurira n'okwetegyereza kuruga omu by'endimi z'omutwe (cognitive psychology) hanyuma bagyeragyeranise n'obuhangwa bwa Locke, baronderere ebiri kufaanana, ebitafaanana, n'ebibuuzo.
answer_d: Mugambire omwegi kushobora enshuraniso aha bitekerezo bya Aristotle eby'obuhangwa bw'okumanya n'ebya Locke, orikwegamira aha matangiriro g'ebitekerezo byabo.

question: Shoma omushomesha naagamba aha biteekateeko bya Jean Paul Sartre ebirikukwata aha bwomeezi bw'abantu. Omwegi omwe naaza omu maisho kugaragaza ngu nikimugumira kwetegyereza eki omuhandiiki arikugamba ngu tihariho muntu w'obuntu. Omu by'okugarukamu ebi omushomesha arikubaasa kugarukamu, eki kiri haihi kumuhwera omwegi kwetegyereza eki Sartre arikugamba?
answer_a: Okutari nk'abantu, ebintu ebyaragirwe omuntu, omuhandiisi nk'eky'okureeberaho, tibirikubaasa kugira obuhangwa bwabyo butakariho obwo obubihairweho obu arikubihanga.
answer_b: Nk'abantu, ebintu ebyakozirwe omuntu, nk'omukozi w'emikono nk'eky'okureeberaho, nibibaasa kugira obumanyiso obw'amaani obwateekwa kubaho, kwonka n'obu kiraabe kityo, nabo bashemereire kuba baho.
answer_c: Ishitwe itwe abantu tituratungwa omuntu, n’ahabw’ekyo tihariho mutima gwangye nari obuntu bw’abantu oburikubaho enyima y’okukoresa n’okuhikiiriza obugabe bwaitu bw’okukora.
answer_d: Abantu bakahangwa omuntu ou twaheebwa obugabe bw’okukora eki turikwenda (obugabe bw’okucwamu); n’ahabw’ekyo, nitwe twonka turikucwamu eki turiba twaba twine kurugiirira aha bikorwa byaitu.

question:
Teeka aha mbeera egi:
Omu klasse y'ebya "Emisingi y'Emitwarize Mirungi", omwegyesa nashoboorora amakuru g'ekigambo "okutengaanwa" nk'oku Jean Paul Sartre yaakishobooroire. Ku araabe naabuuza abegyi be eky'okureeberaho ky'ekigambo eki, omwe ahayo eky'okureeberaho ngu "okutengaanwa n'obu omuntu aba ataire omutima ahabw'okugira omugisha mubi omu by'aboojo."
Niki ekihabire omu ky'okureeberaho eki omwegyi yaahaire?
answer_a: N’ekihabura kukwataganya obusaasi bw’obumuntu n’entekateeka z’obuntu n’embeera zabo, ahabw’okuba omukago n’abandi nigworobiisa kandi niguzibira okuhikiirira nk’omugingo.
answer_b: Tikirikugira kuba nikiba kigufu kuhendera obusaasi bw'obumwe aha ndwara y'omutwe; okushoborora oku nikurugaho okwetegyereza nk'ekintu ekirikubaho.
answer_c: Nikikyamisa kukurwanisa ekiteekateeko ky'okutengurwa kw'obumwe n'embeera z'omutima, ahabw'okuba tikirikwetegyereza omukago gw'okutengurwa n'okumanya obujunaanizibwa.
answer_d: N’ekihabahabi kwegyeragyeranisa obusaasi bw’obumwe n’ebirungo by’okucwererwa amaganya, ahabw’okuba okuremwa omu rukundo nikubaasa kuba enshonga y’obugabe bw’omuntu.

question: Shoma omugambwa ogurikukurataho: Omwegyesa nashoboorora enyegyesa ya Nietzsche aha ntandikiro y'emico, erikushoboororwa omu 'Aha Mutwe gw'Emico'. Omwegi naagira ngu naashagika ebi omuhandiiki arikuteekateeka ahabw'okuba naareetera emico y'ab'amaani, erikurwana n'eya banyantege. Omu matoorezo aga agurikukurataho, ni oruhe orurikushoboorora enshobi erimu omu bigambo by'omwegi?
answer_a: Omwegi orikwegyesa naagyeragyeranisa emiteekateeka y'abakama n'obugabe bw'okukora, naruga omu nshonga z'omutindo gw'ebikorwa.
answer_b: Omwegyeshuri ashanga ngu emicwe ya kihakanisa erikufa erikweteekwa kusingurwa abanyanteera kubaasa kuhika aha muntu orikukira abandi
answer_c: Omwegi orikwegyesa atabura okucwamu obuhangwa bw'abanyanteera n'okureeta emico emihyaka y'abantu.
answer_d: Omwegi orikwegyesa atabura okuhindura emiramizo n'okworeka omuntu ouhingwiremu amaani.

question: Shoma eky'okubanza: Omu bitebe by'enyegyesa "Obugabe obukuru obw'abantu ab'omu Amerika y'omumaisho ga Kolombo", omwegyesa, obu arikushoborora emiringo mikuru y'entebeeka y'eby'obushubuzi y'Abainka, areeba ngu ekikundi ky'abegyeshwa be tikirikwetegyereza ekigambo entebeeka y'eby'obushubuzi erikugabura. Obwo acwamu kushoborora ekigambo eki obundi, kwonka omurundi ogu arikukoresa orugero. Orugero oruha orurikukwatanisa gye n'ekigambo entebeeka y'eby'obushubuzi erikugabura?
answer_a: Ekanisipaali ekagarura abantu abakuru abataagaine esente ezaabaheebwa omwaka ogwahwa ahabw'okutwara ebishushani.
answer_b: Ekibiina kya Telethon kikatongyezaayo kampeyini empya ey’okukungaanya esente nyingi okusinga omwaka oguwedde, era n’ezizo zizimbye ekifo ekipya eky’okubonererezaamu abantu abalemerevu.
answer_c: ONEMI ekakoresa eby'obugaiga ebyabaire biteekanisiibwe Eihanga ahabw'okurwanisa akabi n'okwombeka obutaka obu amaizi gaabaire gajanjagire.
answer_d: Ekigo kya Hogar de Cristo kikendeeza omuhendo gw'amayumba gaabo g'obuyambi.

question: Omuhwezi w’eky’omwaka gwa 5 naaba ayegyesa omutwe “Engaruka z’okutsinda,” nayenda kucungura okumanya kw’abegi be aha ngaruka z’okutsinda aha bantu b’omu Amerika ab’omuriira. Kubaasa kukora eki, akakora ekikoreso ky’okucungura okumanya kwabo. Ni kiratwa ki aha biratwa by’okutsinda eki omwegyesa akakora ekirikugambira aha kigyendererwa ekirikugambwaho?
answer_a: Mushomere aha maapu ebitongore by'abantu ab'omwihangiro ebyahangirwe Abahisipaanyola.
answer_b: Kurugiira, orikurugiira aha meza z'emitindo, omuringo gw'embeera z'abantu omu bwire bw'okutsinda gukaba guri guta
answer_c: Kuruga omu bwiini bw'ebyahandiikirwe ebikuru ebireetera okukendeera kw'omubaro gw'abantu.
answer_d: Kurora, okurikugyenderera aha bishushani ebi, emiringo y’okureebana kw’abantu ab’omu nsi n’abanyagyi?

question:
Shoma omwegyerekano gw'abaana nigo orikushoma omuhandiiko ogurikugamba aha kibiina ky'abantu ab'omuriika (aba-diaguitas) abakora ebintu by'obushuushu. Omuhandiiko nigwojwekanisibwa n'ekishushani ekirikwooreka abakazi nibasheena emmere omu kinu, n'ebibya by'obushuushu haihi nabo.
Omwegyesa naija haihi n'ekibiina eki omwe aha baana nagira ati:
-“Aba bantu ab'omuriika bakakora ebintu by'obushuushu.” “Bakakoresa bintu ebi kukora ki?” Omwegyesa nabuuza.
-“Kushushaanisa amaka,” omwana naahamya.
-Omwegyesa areeba ekishushani naagumizamu: “Ahabw'enki orikuteekateeka ngu bakakoresa ebintu ebyo kushushaanisa?”
-“Niyo maama wangye abigura.”
-Omwana ondiijo yongyeraho ati: “Eego, na maama wangye nayenda ebintu by'obushuushu. Turi n'ebingi omu ka.” [..]
Aisenberg, Beatriz (okuhindura)
Obuzibu ki omu kwetegyereza obwire bw'ebyafaayo oburikworekyerwa omu mbeera egi erikugambwaho?
answer_a: Obugumire bw'okumanya omu bintu ebiturora burijo obumanyiso bw'ebyahandiikirwe eby'ebyafaayo
answer_b: Omuringo gw'okuha ebintu n'embeera amakuru kuruga omu biteekateeko by'omuri obu bwire
answer_c: Oburemeezi bw'okugumira omutindo gw'okwetenga omu bintu ebiragiro ebintu eby'obuganga nk'ebisibo by'ebintu
answer_d: Omuringo gw'okukora enshobyo omu maisho g'embeera ezirikworeka obumwe obugumireho

question: Omuhwezi omuhingurizi omu "Engira y'Okucungurwa kw'Eihanga," omugurusi akagumisiriza abanyeshuri be ab'omu mwaka gwa munaana obushoboorozi bw'okukora n'ebirikugyirwaho ngu bashobore kwetantara enshonga erikushoboorora okukura kw'engira egi. Ni murimo ki ogurikukurira oguraikiriza kukurira ekigyendererwa ekiteirweho aha kika?
answer_a: Kuruga omuhanda ogurikukurira omu Iteeka Ly'Ensi erya Spain erya 1812, niki ekyahindwireho kuruga omu kuhoora Omugabe Ferdinand VII?
answer_b: Yega ebiteekateeko by'Abakriyoori aha bikwaata n'okutandikwa kw'Ekitebe Ekikuru eky'e Cádiz.
answer_c: Orikwenda omu biografi z'abebembezi b'obwetengye, ebyafaayo ebyakozesezibwa kukora enteekateeka y'okutunga obwetengye
answer_d: Shisha omu bigambo by'Abatebe b'Ekikungu Ekikuru Ekya Gavumenti yoona ey'Oburengyerwa-zoba, emisingi y'eby'obufuzi eyaahwereiremu enteekateeka egi.

question: Abeshomesha ab'omu mwaka ogw'omunaana nibabuuza ekibuuzo ekirikukwata aha mutwe "Empinduka y'eby'obuhangwa": Ahabw'enki omutwe ogu nigwetwa Empinduka y'eby'obuhangwa kandi titurakareeba ntaro nari okugyemera okurikuhikiriza eiziina eryo? Kuguura okwetegyereza okurikukyeeya kw'omuhimbo gw'eby'omutaano, niki eki ekikwihiire kwetegyerezebwa omu muringo omusya ogw'omutwe ogu?
answer_a: Okugyenda omu maisho omu by'obuganga (industrialization) kuruga omu muringo ogurikwetenga obushoborozi bwingi (multi-causal approach) nikimanyisa okushoborora oburyo obw'okugyenda omu maisho omu by'obuganga nk'ekintu ekirikurugamu ebintu bingi ebirikukora hamwe. Omu mwanya gw'okureeba ekintu kimwe nk'ensonga nkuru, omuringo ogu nigwetenga ngu tube twine okwetegyereza oburyo ebintu ebi birikukwatana n'oburyo birikukora hamwe kureeta okugyenda omu maisho omu by'obuganga. Ebi nibibaasa kuba ebintu nk'okukura kw'eby'obushoboorozi, empindahinduka omu tekinologia, empindahinduka omu miteekateeko y'abantu, n'oburyo gavumenti erikutegeka. Kurugiirira aha muringo ogu, okugyenda omu maisho omu by'obuganga tikirikuruga omu kintu kimwe, kureka kuruga omu bintu bingi ebirikukora hamwe.
answer_b: Yombeka omulingo gw'okukora ebintu omu makuru nk'omutindo gw'ebintu ebigyenda birikukora hamwe n'amaani gaabyo.
answer_c: Shisha omukoro aha bwire obu Endukururu y'eby'obuhangwa yatandikiiremu.
answer_d: Higa abantu okucuurura n'obwegendereza ebyahandiikirwe ebikwata ku mbeera y'abakozi b'omu makolero.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa n'abeeshuli be omwaka ogwa 6 aha kigyendererwa ky'okwega ekirikukurataho: kworeka omuhanda gw'ebitundu by'eby'obufuzi n'entegyeka by'eihanga. N'ahabw'ekyo, acwireho kuhuura omutwe n'amashuuru agaakuratireho aha kutongwa kw'ekitundu kya Ñuble n'okukuraakuranisa okucwamu: Ekitongore ekikuru kikirize okutongwa kw'ekitundu kya XVI ekya Ñuble. Ekigyendererwa eki, ekyeteekateekire okuhangwa, nikyo kikatonga n'amasaza mashya ashatu. Chile eryagira ekitundu kya ikumi na mukaaga. Eki nikyo kyacwirweho Ekitongore ekikuru aha Orwakashatu oru bwanyima y'okukiriza n'oburaanzi 26, oburaanzi bubiri oburikurwanya, hamwe n'obuteetaba omu muringo gwakyo ogw'obushatu omushinga ogurikutoonga Ekitundu eki kisya ekya Ñuble. Ekigyendererwa eki, ekyeteekateekire okuhangwa, nikyo kiryatonga n'amasaza mashya ashatu: Diguillín (Chillán, Chillán Viejo, Quillón, Bulnes, San Ignacio, El Carmen, Pinto, Pemuco, na Yungay), Punilla (San Carlos, Ñiquén, Coihueco, San Fabián, na San Nicolás), na Itata (Quirihue, Cobquecura, Ninhue, Treguaco, Coelemu, Portezuelo, na Ránquil). Ni bumwe aha bwomeezi oburikukwata aha ntegyeka y'eby'obufuzi n'entegyeka ya Chile obu omweeshuri arikubaasa kukurayo omu mashuuru agaakuratireho?
answer_a: Ebiragiro by'obuhangwa ebirikukoresibwa kukora ekitundu
answer_b: Enyima y'omukura gw'ekicweka nk'ekitongole ky'obutegyeki
answer_c: Ebirikukirira ebihooreza okugabura ekitundu ky'ensi omu bitundu
answer_d: Obutegyeki bw'omutindo gw'ekicweka nk'ekitongole ky'obuteegyeki

question: Kushobera kukora aha mugasho gw'okushoborora emisingye mikuru y'obutebe n'oku erikukoresibwa omu ihanga nk'eky'okureeberaho omu kyasha kya 19, omwegyesa w'ahaishomero ryaagati arikwija kushaba nk'omurimo ogurikubanza kwombeka obuhabuzi bw'obutebe. Abegi baamara kugaba emirimo yaabo, omwegyesa arikwija kuteekateeka omurimo ogwa kabiri ogurikugamire aha kwongera kwomeereza ekiteekateeko eki. Aha mirimo egi erikukurataho, n'oguhe omwegyesa orikumwemerera kukuraaza ekitabo kya kabiri ky'okwega?
answer_a: Teeranira eby’obwomeezi bw’omuntu owaikiririza omuhendo gw’obwegendereza omu ihanga ery’okureeberaho omu kyasha kya 19.
answer_b: Shisha engyekwataine ey'abeeshuri bashobooroirwe n'enyegyesereza nkuru ez'obwesigye omu bwire obwo
answer_c: Teeka omukono gw'ebiro ogurikworeka embeera y'obuteerwa omu bitabo by'obumanyiso omu bwiikaro bw'obuteerwa obutari bumwe
answer_d: Shwijuma omu izooba ry'ebyafaayo kushohora enyegyesa z'obwesigye ezirimu

question: Arikurata omwegyesa arikugyezaho kuhindura omu biteekateeko by'abeeshuri be kurabira omu kwetegyereza ekyahandiikirwe eki?
answer_a: Okuteekateeka ngu okukiraana omu by'obushuubuzi kikatandika n'okuhangwa kwa CORFO
answer_b: Okugira ngu CORFO ekahiga omuhanda gw'okuhindura ebintu by'ekikomo omu Chile
answer_c: Kwetegyereza ngu ekigyendererwa kya CORFO kikaba kwihaho ebizibu ebi abaasaani omu by'enganda y'omushwiga gwa nayitreeti.
answer_d: Kwikiriza ngu ahabw'okutaho CORFO, eihanga rya Chile rikareka kwesigama aha bandi omu by'obushubuzi

question: Ni ngyenderwaho ki ey'eby'obufuzi abanyeshuri abari omu mwaka ogwa kabiri omu mashomero g'ahaiguru bashemereire kwetegyereza kubaasa kuganira aha nshonga y'obuteegyeki bw'ekihogo?
answer_a: Okugyeza abantu baingi munonga
answer_b: Ekyeshomesa ky'eby'obufuzi
answer_c: Okugabura obushoboorozi bw'eihanga
answer_d: Okugumya omwebembezi orikugira engeso y'obuhangwa

question: Omwegyesereza naateekateeka okugyenda omu kubaza eby’omutwe “Okurugaho kw’emitindo y’eby’obufuzi n’eby’obushubuzi etaine kushushana omu kyasha kya makumi abiri,” kandi ekigyendererwa kimwe ky’okwegyesa ekishemereire kupimwa n’okushobora kw’emitwarize y’obutebenesi bw’Abanazi kuruga omu bw’Abasoviyeti. Ahar’ekyo, ebiranga by’okushoma ebi bikurikiyo nibiteekwa: 1.- Naamanya embeera y’ebyafaayo obu obutebenesi bwabugaine. 2.- Natandika omugabo oguhairwe itaka. 3.- Naamanya okukoresa obushoborozi bw’okubuurira obw’eby’obufuzi. 4.- Naamanya omugabo oguhairwe eihanga nk’omukozi omu bantu. N’ebiranga bishani ebi ekigyendererwa ky’okwegyesa ekitekirweho nikishobora kubazibwa?
answer_a: 1 na 2
answer_b: 1 na 3
answer_c:
2. Hingira omuhanda gw'okukora ebintu.
4. Gira amatsiko kandi okore n'amaani.
answer_d:
3. Hingira enshonga nkuru eshatu ezirikureetera abantu kukora ebikorwa ebitahikire.
4. Gamba aha nshonga ina ezirikubaasa kukoresibwa kutaasa obutonde bw'ensi.

question: Omwegyesereza arikutebeekanisa kukora okushomesa kw’okubanza n’abegi b’omwaka ogw’okubanza omu mashomero g’ahaiguru, ahabw’okupima oku bahikireho omu kiragiro ky’okushwijuma omugasho gw’eby’obuhangwa omu kwatanisa ensi yoona kuruga omu byo barikukora buri izooba. Ni bintu ki ebi abegi bashemereire kukora omu kushwijuma?
answer_a: Empaka aha migisha n'obubi bw'okutungaana kw'ensi yoona omu orurembo oru barikugyendera.
answer_b: Okuteekateeka hamwe okushobora obwire obu ekikorwa ky'okutunga omu bwingi kirikutandikira.
answer_c: Omweshango gw'okushambaaza ogurikugamba aha bukuru bw'okuhanga ebintu bisya omu by'okutumaana
answer_d: Omwandiko ogurikukwata aha mugasho gw'okutoora emicwe y'abanyamahanga omu maka gaabo omu myaka ehingwire.

question: Omuhendo gwa ekikomo gwatomboka gwaheza $2.71 aha poundi ahabw'okukura okutarikwetegwa omu China. - Okutunda omu by'oburoobi omu Chile kwongyeireho 12% omu kyakabiri ahabw'okwetenga omu Asia. - Eby'amasente by'envine omu Chile byatendekwa omu nsi yoona: Mbwenu nibyo birungi byabyo? - Eby'obuhangwa bw'emiti n'okuhanga emirimo. Emirimo erikukira omu 300,000 ahabw'okwongyera aha by'okutunda omu mahanga. Ni nshonga ki ezirikukirayo abeeshuri bashemereire kumanya kubaasa kwetegyereza amakuru aga?
answer_a: Okuglobaraiza
answer_b: Ekyangaano ky'eby'obushuubuzi
answer_c: Okukuumira obutonde bw’ensi
answer_d: Okutegyerezibwa kw'eby'obushuubuzi

question: Omuhanda gw'okwegyesa ogurikukurira aha mutwe gw'ekicweka 'Okukoresa obwenegye n'entebeekanisa z'okukiikirira eby'obufuzi', omwegyesa owa mwaka ogw'okana akwata ebiri aha rubaju abegi be kandi abaha obwire bukye kubisoma: Omu mwaka gwa 2011, ebiragiro 20500 bikahandiikwa, ebirikugira ngu nibibaasa kuhanga Enama z'Abantu Omuri Community (COSOC), ezirikugira obuhabuzi kandi zirikubaasa kuhwera kukora ekigyendererwa ky'okukwata aha kutebeekanisa, okukora, n'okushwijuma amateeka ga community, eby'obutegyeki n'okwebembera kw'ekicweka ky'obumwe. Ezi ziteekwa kuteeranira hamwe emirundi ena omu mwaka. [Eitendekyero eriri ahansi ry'Obwebembezi bw'Ebitundu n'Obw'Obutegyeki (Okuhindura)]. Omu myanya y'okwegyesa eri ahansi, niki ekirikubaasa kukorwa n'ebiri aha rubaju ebi?
answer_a: Shuuruura eby'okukora kw'abantu boona omu by'obutebeekanisa by'eihanga
answer_b: Shobokire ky'okukiikirira abantu omu by'obufuzi nikimanyisa ki?
answer_c: Manya emirimo y'ab'obushoboorozi omu bitongole by'ebyaalo.
answer_d: Shobora omuhanda gw'okugabura obushoboorozi bw'eby'obufuzi n'obukuratsi.

question: Shomaishai omubaire omu kicweka ky’eky’eshomo: Omwegyesa Pérez, omwegyesa w’oruzungu, atandika omutwe omusya. Ahandiika “Ekiikaro” aha baabo kandi amanama ekishushani ky’okulangaanisa ekiikaro. Arabuza abegyi be kureeba omutwe gw’ekicweka n’ekishushani nibagabana ebi barikuteekateeka eky’omutwe ogwo guraabe nigukwataho. Bwanyima, arababuza kumanya amataare g’ebikiikaro agarikugambwaho omu okulangaanisa kandi abaha emirimo erikukwata ahari buri rimwe. Kujjuza amakuru, omwegyesa abaha ebintu ebirikukwata aha nkambi z’ebikiikaro z’abato omu US arababuza yaaba baine ekintu ekirikushushana n’ekyo omu ihanga ryabo. Ku baraamara, agira ngu baraahuurira okugamba kw’eka erikucwamu ahu baraaza kuza omu kiikaro ekirikwija. Okuhwaaho, ashaba kuteekateeka ebigambo n’embeera ezigambirweho enyima ebi barikuteekateeka ngu baraahuurira omu kugamba. Eky’aha muheru, Omwegyesa Pérez n’abegyi be bahurira okugamba kandi bareeba ebi bateekateeka. Omwegyesa arikukora ki omu mbeera y’ekicweka ky’eshomo eyo?
answer_a: Naaba nayereeta omutwe gw'ekicweka ky'ebirikwenda kwegwa.
answer_b: Naaba ari kukora emirimo y'omu kanwa omu ক্লাাসirooni kuba abeeshuri bateekateeke aha mutwe gw'ekicweka.
answer_c: Narikukoresa emiteekateeka y'okuhurikiza ahabw'okushoborora omutwe gw'ebyahandiikwa n'okureetera abeeshuri kugira omutima gw'okwega.
answer_d: Naabaasaasya ebikorwa by’obuhangwa buzima, abegi baashobora kwetegyereza omutwe n’obwomeezi bwabo, kandi bagambe ebi barikuteekateeka.

question: Ahabwe nibiki ekirikora egloobu kugira omugasho nk'ekikoreso ky'okwegyesa?
answer_a: Ahabw’okuba nikikiriza kureeba emiterere y’Ensi nk’eri.
answer_b: Ahabw’okuba nikiyamba kumanya obwinganisa bw’ebice byombi eby’ensi omurundi gumwe
answer_c: Ahabw’okuba nikikwasiza kwega obugazi bw’ensi omu bwijwire.
answer_d: Ahabw’okuba nikikora ngu oronde ahantu hoona aha nsi omu buringaaniza

question: Shoma omubaro ogurikukurataho: Omwegyesa w’omu mwaka gwakabiri owa pulayimare akoreka abegyi be meepu y’ebitundu bya Chile eby’omu Mashuuma, hamu na hagati, n’eby’omu Kashuuma. Bwanyima, akabareetera ebishushani by’ebitundu ebi, yaabashaba kushinga omu rubaraaru ebishushani by’omu mashuuma; omu kyererezi, eby’omu hagati; na omu mwirandu, eby’omu kashuuma. Omurimo ogu gukuruha munonga aha mugambi gwaha?
answer_a: Taahura ebitaano by'ensi omuhanda gw'ebiragiro by'ebitundu by'ensi.
answer_b: Geranisire ebyanga by'ensi omuhendo gwabyo n'okurugiirira aha miterere yabyo
answer_c: Shuuruura ebiranga by'ebitundu by'ensi omuhanda.
answer_d: Shangaaza ebishushani by'obutaka omu byanya by'ensi ebirikushushana n'obushangwa bwabyo

question: Shoma omuhanda ogurikukurataho: Omwegyesa ari kukora emirimo erikugyenderera kugasobora abeeshure kubasa kushoborra omukago ogwabaho hagati y'Abamapuuce n'Abanya Spain omu bwire bw'obukoloni. Kuti ahabw'ekyo, akora omurimo ogw'okubanza ogurikwegamira aha kihandiiko eki: Omu runkoni orwakwatirwe omu Paicaví omu mwaka gwa 1605, kikateekwa ngu abantu abari aha nsalo baine kwetangira omusoro murungi omu bintu, obuhereza bw'omuntu bugazirirwe. Kuba bakaba nibaha abantu okukora omu matongo g'Abanya Spain, bakaba nibashurwa esente za silver nari ebiri kumulingana nazo. Kandi, bakaba baine kuza omu rugamba kurwana n'abazigu b'Omugabe. Abahindi bakagarukamu nibashemererwa ngu nibaija kuguma omu mirembe, "[...] ahabw'okuba Obukuru bwe bukaba bukozire aha nshonga nkuru ey'obujeemu bwabo n'omuti gwabwo, ogwabire obuhereza bw'omuntu obu bajeemire [...]". Nikwetegyerezebwa, hati, ngu omu myaka egi Abahindi abanywani bakaba bakyariire kuruga omu kitundu ky'Abahindi ab'encomienda. Bakatandika, kwonka, kwolesa embeera yaabo ey'omutaano -kuruga omu kyasha ekyahwereire-, ahabw'okuba bakaba batakyari Abahindi abaza omu rugamba n'abakama baabo ab'encomienda kuruga omu kitundu ekya hagati y'eihanga, kureka Abahindi ab'encomienda kuruga omu kitundu kimwe eky'obutabangaanisa. Aha rubaju orundi, embeera yaabo ekaba eteirezaho kyorobezebwa kuraba omu kuzirika obuhereza bw'omuntu, ensonga nkuru ey'okutashemererwa kwabo. Abahindi abanywani aha nsalo ya Araucania, (Andrea Ruiz-Esquide). Ng'okwegamira aha kihandiiko ekiri ahaiguru, murimo ki ogurikushobora kwetenga kuba abeeshure nibamanyisa omukago ogwabaho hagati y'Abamapuuce n'Abanya Spain omu bwire bw'obukoloni?
answer_a: Nibakora ekipande ekirikugamba aha kigendererwa ky'endagaano ya Paicaví.
answer_b: Nibarikiriza kuruga omu kashushani endagaano nkuru eziri ahagati y'Abamapuche n'Abanya Spain
answer_c: Basimbire aha miringo yoona ey'omukago hagati y'Abanya Spain na Mapuche kandi muhangire akakaadi k'omutwe gw'ekiganiro ahari buri gumwe.
answer_d: Nibarikira aha Intebe y'amateeka ya Paicaví kandi bagambe oku ensalo hagati y'ebitebe byombi eya hindukireho omu bwire obuhingwire

question:
Shoma omuhanda ogurikukurira:
Aha muheru gw'ekicweka "Eby'Obuhunguzi bwa Athens," ekimu aha bigendererwa omwegyesa yaabaire naayenda kushwijuma kikaba kiri okwetegyereza emicwe mikuru y'obutegeki bwa demokarasi omu Athens, kandi okushwijuma omutindo gw'okuhikiirira, akashaba abegyi be kuzooba akacweka k'okuringanisa aha butegeki bwa demokarasi omu Athens n'obutegeki bwa demokarasi bwa Chile obwa hati. Okushwijuma eby'okugarukamu, akatebeekanisa omwegyereko ogurikuruga aha bintu ebirimu okugyenda omu maisho kw'ebyafaayo n'ebitariyo.
Ni endaga ki aha ndaga zirikukurira ezirikworeka okumanya ekintu ky'okuhinduka aha butegeki bwa demokarasi bwombi?
answer_a: Nikiriza obuhangwa bw'obukuru omu itendekyero
answer_b: Nikumanya enshuraniso omu mirimo y'obutegeki
answer_c: Niki ekirikworeka omulingo abantu barimu omu biteekateeko by'obulemi?
answer_d: N'omanya obushoborozi bw'okuba omuturage bwihirweho ebiragiro ebirikwetagisa okuhikiirizibwa

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa wa Philosophy orikutebeekanisa eishomo aha biteekateeko by'embeera y'obutonde kuruga omu ndaaza ya J. Locke, T. Hobbes, na J.J. Rousseau, kandi ekigyendererwa ky'entebeekanisa egi niki: "Okutangaanisa enyegyesa ezi n'emitwarize y'omuntu ey'obutonde (omugabe, ow'obwengye, n'omuntu w'abantu)." Ebikorwa ebiteikirweho omwegyesa ebiri aha hansi nibihaabi byabaasa kugasira abegyi be kutunga ekigyendererwa ky'eishomo eri?
answer_a: Abeshomesha niboonyereza aha biteekateeko by'embeera y'obuntu omuhandiiki omu omwe kandi bagarukira omwegyesa n'ebi baroondoozire.
answer_b: Abeshomesha nibashwijuma omukago oguli ahagati y'obumanyirizi bw'Abangereza n'embeera y'obutonde okurugiira aha biteekateeko by'omuntu.
answer_c: Abeshomesha nibakunganya amakuru aha muringo gw'obuntu bw'omuntu kandi nibagashuuruura omu bitabo byabo.
answer_d: Abeshomesha bashoma ekitabo ekirikukwata aha biteekateeko by'omuhandiiki omu nshonga y'obuhangwa, barondera enshuraniso n'okushushana kwabyo.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa n'abakuru b'omu mashomero ga siniya aha biteekateeko bya J.J. Rousseau ebiri aha by'obufuzi, narwo naasinga kwikiriza aha biteekateeko by'okugonza kw'abantu boona, ekyo omufilosofo Omufaransa yakozesa omu kitabo kye eky'Endagaano y'Abantu (1762). Omu bintu ebiri ahansi, ekirikukurataho nikyo kirikworeka eky'okurugiraho ekirikusaana kworeka abegi aba ekiteekateeko ky'okugonza kw'abantu boona?
answer_a: Okuronda omuhanda gw'okutoora abebembezi b'eklassi kuraba omu kuronda orukira abantu kukira abandi.
answer_b: Okutwara abeeshure boona n'abareezi kukwatanisa hamwe kuhikaana aha ndagaano
answer_c: Okugyenda omu maisho n'okuhiga abegi omu class, nangwa n'obu harimu abamwe abatarikukyetenga
answer_d: Okuteera enteekateeka ahaagati y'abeeshuri abarikukirukana omu biteekerezo kubaasa kuhikaana omu rukurato ry'ekiro.

question: Shoma omushomo ogurikukurataho: Omu kiraasi aha biteekateeko bya Plato, omwegyesa nashoboorora emiringo mikuru y'ebiteekateeko bya Plato, omuri yo naragira ngu 'ekiteekateeko kimwe na kimwe n'eky'omutaano, kikiriraana n'ekirikukirayo obukuru omu mutwe gw'ebintu'. Omwegi, yafeerwa, agarukamu ngu eki tikirikubaasa kuba kandi n'ahaayo eky'okureeberaho ngu ekiteekateeko nikiteekateekwa abantu babiri, embeera erikuraburura obumwe bw'ekiteekateeko. Orikurora aha biteekateeko bya Plato, ni nshonga ki erikushoboorora enshonga erikukurira omu nshobe y'omwegi?
answer_a: Omwegi ashuubiza ngu ebiteekateeko nibirikuruga omu kuteekateeka hamwe.
answer_b: Omwegi asobora kwetegyereza ngu ebiteekateeko biriho ahabw'obwengye.
answer_c: Omwegi naatekateeka ngu ebiteekateeko nibishushana
answer_d: Omwegyeshuri ashanga ngu ebiteekateeko biri omu nsi ey’obwengye.

question: Omuhendiki n’omwegi omu ishomero rikuru aha Byafaayo by’Obwengye nibakora aha biteekerezo bya R. Descartes. Ni eki ki aha bigambo ebi ekirikubaasa kureetera abegi oburemeezi, ekirikukwatana n’okwetegyereza ekigambo “Ninteekereza, n’ahabw’ekyo ndiho”?
answer_a: Shuuruura obuhangwa bw'ekiteekerezo kya Descartes (Cartesian cogito)
answer_b: Eihangaanisa okubaho n'okukoresa okuteebereza okurikukuratira omuringo.
answer_c: Teekateeka ngu okubaho nikurikwatira aha bikorwa by'okuteekateeka.
answer_d: Huura aha kubaho kwa res cogitans n'okubaho kwa res extensa

question: Omugyezibwa naayegyesa abegyeshwa be ab'omwaka gwa kashatu omu mashomero agari haihi, omuringo gw'okutunga obwengye kuraba omu bihurizo. Ni nshonga ki aha ziri ahansi enu, abegyeshwa bashemereire kuba bamaze kwega, kubaasa kwetegyereza eky'obuhurizi?
answer_a: Obwihangane
answer_b: Okuhurira
answer_c: Ekirora
answer_d: Okuteeraho omutima

question: Omu omuri yuniti y’Eishomero rya hagati: Emitwarize y’eby’obufuzi, omwegyesa naija kukora aha bigambo ebyahimbisibwe T. Hobbes: "homo homini lupus". Ni nshonga ki aha ziri ahansi aha abeeshuri bashemereire kuba nibamanya kare kubaasa kwetegyereza ebigambo ebyagambirwe?
answer_a: Eky'obuteeka
answer_b: Endagaano y'obuhangwa
answer_c: Eitaka ly'omuntu omwe
answer_d: Embeera y'obutonde

question: Omugyezibwa w’omuishaayi owa sekenda ari kwetebeekanisiza ekicweka aha by’omuteekateeki gwa Kant kukwata aha bushobozi bw’okumanya; ahabw’ekyo, ashemereire kumanya ebintu abegi be bamaze kwega ebirikubasa kubahwera kwetantara omuteekateeki ogwo. Ni bintu ki abegi abamazire kwega ebi omugyezibwa ashemereire kumanya kubaasa kwetantara omuteekateeki ogu?
answer_a: Manyisa ebitekerezo bya D. Hume na J. Locke nk'ebyakabanza eby'omuteekateeki eri ekiteekerezo kya I. Kant
answer_b: Yetegyereze okwetenga aha mazima kw'Abangereza n'okukuratira ebimanyiriro nk'emigye eyabaireho enyima y'ekiteeso kya Kant
answer_c: Shobora omumaro gw'obwire n'obw'omwanya nk'emitwarize y'okuteekateeka erikwetagisa kumanya, nk'oku I. Kant yaagigambire.
answer_d: Yeteerera amakuru g'ekintu ekirikubonwa n'ekirikuteebwa nk'okushoboorora kwa Kant aha kiki ekirikubaasa kumanywa

question: Okwetegyereza omugasho gw'enyegyesa y'okwetaba omu buntu bwa Plato.
answer_a: Ebirikutaana omuhanda gw'okwetegyereza "episteme" na "doxa"
answer_b: Tebeekanisa ebiteekateeko bya Platoni okurikurugaana n'omutindo gw'okuhikiirira
answer_c: Shobora amoko gashatu g'emyoyo omu mugani gw'eigareeta
answer_d: Shuushanura enshoborozi y'ensi ey'okumanya n'ey'okuteekateeka.

question: Omugyezaho orikwegyesa nashoma omu kiraasi n'abegi be emishomo ebiri ey'okubanza eya R. Descartes ey'okuteekateeka aha bintu ebirikukiraho amagara n'ebirikureebwa, aine ekigyendererwa ky'okukora aha kigyendererwa ky'okwega ekirikukurataho: 'Okumanya n'okucwamu okwetenga kw'obwengye okwa R. Descartes.' Omu mirimo erikukurataho ei abegi barakore, niki ekiraahwere aha kumanya ngu ekigyendererwa ekyo kyahikiirirwe?
answer_a: Nibashobora kushoborora enshonga ezirikukwata omutwe ezirikushangwa omu biteekateeko bibiri eby'okubanza ebya R. Descartes ebikwata aha by'obutonde bw'ebintu
answer_b: Nibarikira omuringo ogwa Cartesian ogurikukwata aha by'ekibaro ogurikushangwa omu biteekateeko bibiri eby'okubanza ebya R. Descartes eby'ahaiguru y'omubiri.
answer_c: Nibarikira enshonga ya Cartesian ey'okubanganisa okutari kw'amazima erikworekwa omu biteekateeko bibiri eby'okubanza ebya metaphysical ebya R. Descartes
answer_d: Nibamanya emiteekateeka ya Descartes erikukwata aha ku omuntu arikumaramu ekyetengo kurabira omu bintu ebi arikureeba n'amaisho, nk'oku kirikushangwa omu biteekateeko bibiri eby'okubanza eby'okwetegyereza ebya R. Descartes.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'ekicweka kya 12, aha muheru gw'ekicweka ekirikukwata aha Bizibu bya Metafizika na Epistemoloji, naateekateeka kucungura ekigyendererwa ky'okwega ekirikukurataho: 'Kwetegyereza enshobano za epistemoloji eziri ahagati y'empirizimu na rasionalizimu.' Ni murimo ki abeeshuri baraakora ngu omwegyesa asobole kucungura ekigyendererwa eki kirikugambwaho?
answer_a: Taabu erimu omuteerane gw'ebitekerezo ebirukugwirirana aha nshonga ezi zombi
answer_b: Teeka omutendera gw'ebirikuru eby'omutwe ebya J. Locke na R. Descartes.
answer_c: Yoreka omuhanda ogurikworeka obutandikiro bw'okumanya omu biteekateeko by'okwetegyereza (empiricism) n'okukoresa obwengye (rationalism)
answer_d: Tebeekanisiza ebigambo ebirikushushana omuhanda gw'okumanya kurugiirira ahari D. Hume na J. Locke

question: Shoma omuhanda ogurikukurira: Aha muheru gw'ekicweka "Okukura kw'Ababurugwaazi", ekimu aha bigendererwa omwegyesa yaashuuruurizeho kikaba kiri okwetegyereza emico mikuru y'oburangwaazi omu kyasha kya 19. Eki, abeeshuri bakashabwa kutebeekanisa lipooti ehandiikirwe. Ebirikumanyisa ebiri aha hansi nibirikubaasa kushuururwa kworeka ekigendererwa eki kirikugambwaho?
answer_a: Nekikuruuga omu bwinganisa ab’embeera y’obushomerezi nk’omuntu ouhinguraine omu by’obufuzi omu nkyukakyuuka ezabaho omu kyasha kya 19
answer_b: Nikiriza omuringo gw'obwomeezi bw'abakungu, ebi baroota aha muntu omwe, hamwe n'ekiteekateeko ky'obwomeezi bw'eka.
answer_c: Orikukora ebyahandiikirwe ebiriho ebikwata aha kwetaba kw'abanyaburujuazia n'endimi zabo ez'obureeberezi omu kukuza n'okugyenda omu demokarasi y'enkora y'obulemi omu kyasha kya 19.
answer_d: Geranisiriza emirimo mikuru y'eby'obushubuzi eyaakozirwe abagagga omu kyasha kya 19, orikutandika empinduka n'okugumaho n'egy'obu obu.

question: Omugyezibwa naayenda kushwijuma ahabw'okukoresa ekihandiiko, yaaba abegi be baatunga amanya g'ebyarugiremu aha muheru gw'olutalo orw'obutiti. Ni ekihe aha mirimo egi ekirikushwijuma ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Eizooba omuhendo gw'eby'obufuzi ogwatebeekanisibwe Glasnost omu USSR nk'ekimu aha byahandiikire enkomerero y'olutalo orw'obutiti.
answer_b:
Reagan na Gorbachev bakozire ki omu ku kuhereza omutwe Omurwanangwe Rubaire?

Reagan na Gorbachev bakozire ebintu by’omugaso muno omu kuhereza omutwe Omurwanangwe Rubaire. Okukiraho, Reagan akagumizamu n’okugumya amagye ga America, eki kikahiga Soviet Union kwongyera sente omu by’amagye byabo, eki kikatwara sente nyingi ezirukukiraho. Eki kikatwara Soviet Union omu buzibu bw’eby’obushomesha. Reagan akakoresa obwomeezi bwe obw’amaani okuhiga Gorbachev kukora empinduka.

Gorbachev, akaba ari omwebembezi wa Soviet Union, akatandika amateeka ag’empinduka nka "Perestroika" (okwombeka obuhya eby’obushomesha) na "Glasnost" (okugarura omulingo gw’okugamba). Empinduka ezi zikahereza abantu obugabe bw’okugamba n’okukora eby’obushomesha, eki kikahereza abantu amaani. Gorbachev akemereza okukozesa amaani omu bihugu bya Eastern Europe, eki kikahereza ebihugu ebi amaani okwehayo kuruga omu bukulembezi bwa Soviet Union. Okutungaana kwa Reagan na Gorbachev kukahereza omukisa gw’okumala Omurwanangwe Rubaire omu mutindo gw’obusinge.
answer_c: Shobora kimwe n’obutaano bumwe aha miringo ebiri y’okushwijuma ebyafaayo erikukwata aha muheru gw’olutalo orw’obutiti.
answer_d: Obushoboorozi bw’ensi omu nsi yoona bukaba buteebemberwe butya bwanyima y’okuhwaho kw’olutalo orw’obutiti?

question: Omwegyesereza asomesa naija kutandika omutwe 'Enkoresa y'eby'obushomesha n'omugasho gwazo omu itaka', aine ekigyendererwa ky'okureetera abegi be ab'omu mashomero aga haihi kwetegyereza empinduka ezigwirireho ebushangwa bw'omunsi ahabw'omukago oguri hagati y'eby'obushomesha, abantu, n'entebeekanisa y'ebifo. N'ahabw'ekyo, yaacwireho kutandika eishomo arikwihurira amakuru g'ekigambo ebushangwa bw'omunsi, kuraba omu kubuuza abegi omu bibinja. Omu by'okugarukamu ebyahairwe abegi, ebyabaire nibishoborora ebushangwa bw'omunsi kuruga omu bintu byabwo ebirikureebwa nari ebyobutonde byonka nibyo byabaire birukirayo, nibabiha omugisha gw'okuguma omu muringo ogwa wakati n'ogwa iraingwa. Kurugiirira aha mahame g'okwegyesa agaagira omwegyesa w'eby'obushangwa bw'omunsi, nirihe ihame erikuru ery'okukoraaho kubaasa kwongyera aha biteekateeko by'ebushangwa eki kibinja ky'abegi eki kiriku?
answer_a: Okuhuzaana
answer_b: Omwanya
answer_c: Okurugirana
answer_d: Enteekateeka y'ebintu kuruga omu kindi

question: Omuhwezi: Niwe orikushobora kushoborora enshuraniso eri ahagati y'eihanga n'obugabe? Omwegi 1: Eihanga tihirikubaasa kugira obugabe kandi eihanga ririkubaasa kwesherenganisa omu bugabe oburikukira omwe. Omwegi 2: Ota? Tindikumanya eki yaagizire. Obwo, omuhwezi acwamu ngu orurembo orurikukuraho nirwija kutandika n'okwohereza eky'okurorraho ekirikushoborora eky'omwegi ogw'okubanza yaagizire. Omu kicweka ki omurimo gurikwoherezibwa ogurikushobora kushoborora omukago oguri ahagati y'ebirikwetwa eihanga n'obugabe?
answer_a: Reeba akata egombolola eri ahansi kandi orondooze ekyeragiriro ekirikugyenda omu maisho.
answer_b: Shoma ekishushani ky'omutwe ogurikukurira ahaiguru, reero ogeragyeranise n'omutwe gw'eihanga.
answer_c: Reeba omuhendo ogurikukurataho, orondooze ekitabo eki, ohaburemu ebigambo byaawe, orondooze obutumwa oburikukirimu.
answer_d: Shoma ebirikukurataho, ogeranise n'ebirikukwata aha biteekateeko ebi byombi.

question: Ni enki aha mirimo erikukurira abeeshure ab'omumwaka gwa kabiri abato kwohereka okwetegyereza kwabo aha biteekateeko by'okutaguma omu mwanya gumwe n'okutuura omu mwanya gumwe nibarikukwatana n'abantu b'aba Chonos, ekikundi ky'abantu omuri Chile?
answer_a: Ebyato ebyaba Chono bakozesezaga omu kwambukira amazzi bikaba biteebwa bita?
answer_b: Shana Chonos aha maapu y'omubiri ogwa Chile
answer_c: Abachono bakaba nibatunga bata ebyokurya byabo?
answer_d: Shushana abahabura b'Aba Chono omu butaka bwabo obw'omuringo gwaabo

question: Omugyezibwa omu, omuhendereza omu, omu klasse y'abato, omu klasse erikugambira aha "Okushoborora embeera y'obuhangwa bw'obuteera bwa Rooma", nagambira abeeshuli kuhandiika eby'orugyendo omu kicweka ky'ekihanga kya Italy, ahu bashemereire kushuuruura ebintu by'omushiri n'oburungi bw'ebifo ebi barikutaayaayira, nibakoresa ebigambo by'eby'obuhangwa ebi baayegire. Kutiinisa omurimo ogu, abeeshuli, nibahwerwa omugyezibwa, nibateera omugisha gw'orugyendo kandi nibagushushaniisa aha maapu, nibatoora ebibuga bya Rooma ebi baraarabaamu, nibakoresa ebiragiro kuruga omu nshuro ez'omutaano kuteera amagara g'ebintu by'obuhangwa bya buri kitundu. Omu bintu ebi ndikukurira, eki ki kirungi kushuuruura ebi abeeshuli bakozire nibakuratira ekigyendererwa ky'omurimo ogukozirwe?
answer_a: Nibarikwata amaziina g'ebitundu eby'aharwaaro obuteerane bwa Rooma bwateeraniire.
answer_b: Nibarikira aha maanisha g'obuhangwa bw'abaroma bwateeraniziibwe omu muhanda ogurikumanyisa.
answer_c: Nibarikiriza ebintu bikuru ebigizire omubyanga by'ensi ebirukuratirwa omu muhanda ogurukugambwaho
answer_d: Nibarikiriza emihanda kuruga omu bicweka by'ensi ebi obugabe bwa Rooma bwaakuriiremu

question: Omwegyesi aine ekigendererwa ky'okukuratanisa ekigyendererwa ky'okwega ekirikukwata aha Biteera aha Mbeera y'Obuzaare n'Obutwaatsi: 'Kwetegyereza emirimo erikukorwa ab'omu maka gaabo n'ab'omu kitongore n'okuheereza kwabo aha mbeera y'obusingye.' Ni mateeka ki agasaanire kukuraaza ekigyendererwa ky'okwega eki?
answer_a: Genda otembeire omu kataare akurikukurirana, oragiire abaana kugura ebijanjaaro n'emiti, barikugyenda omuhanda gwona gwona.
answer_b: Tebeekanisa omubyeyi aije atugambire eby'okutandika kw'ekyanga n'okuhinguka kwakyo omu bwire obuhingwire.
answer_c: Genda ogyendere omu maduuka g'omu kyaro kandi osabe abaana kubuuza, n'ebibuuzo ebirikutebeekanizibwa, abantu abarikukoraayo.
answer_d: Gyeenda ohingurukye ekyaro ekirikwegamireho, kandi omu myanya etaire, shaba abaana kushiiga abantu abarikubata omutima.

question: Omugyezibwa, ari omu kicweka ky'abegyesi kurikutebeekanisa omutwe "Okutaabanira kw'Ensi Ibiri", atunga obuhabuzi kuruga aha mukozi mugyenzi we kumubuurira kwongyera aha bikorwa ebi yaakozeseize gye omwaka ogwahwaire kwongyera amaani aha kukora n'ebirikurugwamu. Ekikorwa eki kyakubaire: 1. Shoma ekyahandiikwa eki: Castile ekaba emaaze kucwekyereza obugabe bwa Granada, ekigo kya nyuma ekya Islam omu kicweka kya peninsular, n'obuhwezi bwa Aragonese, kandi ekaba eri omu muringo gw'okugaziya amaani, nk'oku kirikworekwa omu kuhingura oku. Enteerane z'orugamba ruraira ahari Granada zikaba zihwereize, omu bindi, kutebeekanisiza obuhangwa bw'eby'orugamba n'okutandika n'obuhangwa obuhyahya omuri byo. Kandi, obuhangwa bw'okwambuuka amaizi bukaba butebeekaniiziibwe munonga omu kyasha kya ikumi na etaano, kandi Castile ekaba eshoboirwe kuba, omu bwire bwa Trastámara, amaani g'amaato n'eby'obushuubuzi omu miringo ya Atlantic na Mediterranean. Spain kuruga omu kyasha kya ikumi na ishatu kuhika ikumi na etaano: Empindahinduka z'Obufuzi bw'Abami bwa Hafihi, Francisco Javier Fernández 2. Shoboorora, orikuruga omu kyahandiikwa, embeera z'eby'obufuzi, eby'entaasi, n'eby'obuhangwa omuri Spain ezahwereize okugaziya. Noorekire ngu eby'okushobora ebi nibyo by'okucuurura n'okukora n'ebirikurugwamu ebirikuteekateekwa omu muringo gw'omwegyesi, ni birikuriisahe byaahwereizibwa ekikorwa eki ekirikubuurwa?
answer_a: Tebeekanisa ebitekerezo kurugiirira aha buhame
answer_b: Shuuruura eky'omuhandiiki eky'ebyafaayo.
answer_c: Ninkumanya ekigyendererwa ky'ebirikurugamu
answer_d: Teeka omuganyulo gw'amanyonyooro agabweireyo.

question: Omwegyesereza, ahabw’ekicweka “Obwetengyeerwa bwa Chile”, ari kukora enteekateeka egi: Ekigyendererwa ky’okwegyesa: Kushoboorora oku obwetengyeerwa bwa Chile bwaakuzire, orikureeba abantu n’emitwe eyaazindaine, abashaija n’abakazi abakumire, okugyenda omu maisho n’okuruuga enyima kw’ensonga y’abarikukunda eihanga, n’ebintu ebikuru ebyabaireho. Ekigyendererwa ky’ekicweka: Kutaana omu biteekateeko by’abarikukunda eihanga n’abeesigwa aha gavumenti aha bikwaata aha kuheebwa obwetengyeerwa. Obureezi bw’okuteekateeka oburikukuzibwa: Okuteekateeka omu bwengye. Aha mirimo ei orikubaasa kukora, niki ekirikukwatana n’ebigyendererwa by’ekicweka kandi ekirikubaasa kwongyerwamu omu nteekateeka?
answer_a: Yijuza ekishushani ekirikworeka omuringo gw'okwetungira obwetungye.
answer_b: Yombeka orukurato rw'ebishushani orurikugambaho aha mazina g'abazira b'Obwetengyeerwa.
answer_c: Sindika ememme ishatu ezirikworeka ebi abantu ab’emitwaro etaine batungire omu muringo gw’okwetungira obwetegyeki
answer_d: Kora vidiyo y'obumunutu bubiri erikugaruramu ekintu ekimwe ekyahikireho omu bwire bw'Obwetengyeerwa

question: Aha kubanza kw'ekicweka "Okucwekyera kw'obutegeki bw'abantu n'obwire bw'obutegeki bw'ekinyoma", omwegyesa arikushaba abegi be ab'omukaaga kukora omu bibinja kujuza akakuru k'ebiro n'ebintu by'omutaano ebi baahuriire ebyahindura ebyafaayo bya Chile okuva 1970 kuhika 1990. Obu arikukurikiraniza omulimo, areeba omwe omuri abaana beegi arikugamba n'amaani muno abandi beegi: "Kurungi, kwonka, n'oha orikusaasirwa ahabw'obutegeki bw'amagye?" Tukuratiire ekikaguzo ky'omwegi, buzibu ki omu kwega ebyafaayo ebirikubaasa kuteebwa?
answer_a: Oburemeezi bw'okushoboorora ebintu kurugiira aha bwire buri bumpi.
answer_b: Okureetera okucwekyereza okucweekamu kw'okushwijuma ebyarikureetera ebintu kuruga omu biteekateeko by'obwire obu turimu
answer_c: Okubura kubaasa kucwamu ebirikushoboorora eby'ebyafaayo omuhanda gw'eby'obufuzi guri ahagati
answer_d: Obutamanya bw’enshonga nyingi ezirikworeka ebyabaho omu byafaayo

question: Omugyezibwa omu, omuhendeki owa 7 omu, omu mutwe "Ensi ezagambiriire omu kuzimbwa kw'obuhangwa bw'Oburengyerwa-izooba", akatebeekanisiza ekicweka arikugyenderera kucwamu Bahari ya Mediterranean nk'obucweka bw'okutambura n'okuhana, arikugyenderera kukuraaza obureezi bw'okuteekateeka eby'ensi, oburikukwataniisa n'okwetegyereza okugaburiranwa kw'ebifo n'emitindo erikugyenderera n'amaani g'obuteeka. Kurugiirira aha kutebeekanisiza ekicweka, ni ebikorwa ki ebiraabe biremirwe kucwamu yaaba abeeshuri bahikiire aha bigyendererwa by'okwega ebirikwetegwa?
answer_a: Yolesa omuhanda n'ebirikutwariramu enyanja ya Mediterranean, orikukoresa maapu y'eby'obufuzi eya hati
answer_b: Shobora eby’okuhereza ebintu omu nsi ezigyezireho enyanja ya Mediterranean, orikukoresa maapu y’ebyafaayo
answer_c: Huurira aha maapu y'omubiri emiteremo y'ebintu eby'obutonde ebirikushangwa omu kicweka kya Mediterranean.
answer_d: Yoreka ebiragiro ebirukukwata aha by'obutegyeki bw'Enyanja ya Mediterranean okuraba omu kubangaanisa ebiteekateeko.

question:
Omwegyesereza naatekateeka eishomo ry’omutwe "Ensi Etaineine Ruhanga omu Chile: ebintu by’omubiri bikuru n’eby’obugaiga by’ebitundu by’obutonde ebirikushushana omu ihanga", erigambirira kwikiriza abegi b’ekicweka kya 5 kumanyisa ebitundu bikuru eby’obutonde bya Chile n’oburanga bwabyo, nibareeba ahu biherereire. Eki nikibaasa, nibaija kwetebeekanisa omurimo gw’aha muheru ogurikwija kubakonyera kumanya yaaba ekigyendererwa kyahikiirirwe.
Ni murimo ki aha myanya erikukurataho ogurikubaasa kukoresibwa kupima ekigyendererwa eki kigambirwe ky’eishomo eryo?
answer_a: Ruhanga ekiikaro ky'ebitundu by'obutonde bwa Chile, orikukoresa obubonero oburikukuratirwa.
answer_b: Geranisiza ebiruka bya Chile orikukoresa ebishushani n'emeepu ez'omutaano
answer_c: Shangaaza ebyanya by'abarambuzi ebirikumanywa omu bitundu bya Chile buri kimwe orikukoresa enkoreso y'ebiragiro by'ebifo omu bwengye bw'ensi.
answer_d: Shana aha maapu ebyanya by'obutonde ebya Chile ebi oragyendera n'eka yaawe, oza kubishoboorora.

question: Omwegyesereza, omuheereza omu ishomero omu mutwe “Entunguka y’eby’obufuzi ya Chile”, ari kutebeekaniza eishomo eriraamugambire aha musingi gw’okukiikirira kandi arakuheyo eby’okureeberaho by’ebifo ebirondwa abantu boona, arikugira ekigyendererwa ky’okureetera abanyeshuri be ab’ekicweka kya 6 nari 7 kwetegyereza “Obukuru bw’okuronda abantu boona ahabw’entunguka ya demokarasi y’Eihanga rya Chile”. Twaba niturora ekigyendererwa ky’eishomo, endaga ki aha zirikukurataho erikuba erikwetenga okushobora abanyeshuri aha muheru gw’eishomo eryo?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza abantu abarikutoorwa omu kuronda, kuba omwezirikiizi w’abantu boona
answer_b: Nibarikiriza obukuru bw'abakuru abatoorainwe omu kucwamu ebirikukwata aha mugisha gw'abantu boona
answer_c: Nibarikiriza omikorere mikuru y'abakuru abarikukiikirira abantu b'omu nsi bwabaireho okutoorana.
answer_d: Nibarikurira ebiragiro by’emitwarize ya demokulasi etari emwe n’emwe erikukorwa omu bantu n’omu mbeera yaabo eza haihi.

question: Omwegyesa orikwegyesa, obu arikworeka emiramu n'empisa, nagamba ngu eki kirungi ahari abamwe tikirikuba kirungi ahari abandi. Omwegi arikugarukamu nagira ati: "Ebi n'enshonga ezirikuruga omu biteekateeko by'abantu kandi omuheru byona nibiruga omu biteekateeko, nikyo ahabw'enki ebintu ebimwe birungi ahari abamwe kandi bitari birungi ahari abandi." Oburemeezi ki oburikubaasika kumanywa omu bigambo by'omwegi?
answer_a: Okwetegyereza omulingo ogw'okutwara ebintu omu bwomeezi nk'okugamba ngu embeera z'obuntu zigwiira omu mulingo ogutali gumu
answer_b: Okuhakanisa okuhinduka kw'emisango y'empisa kurugiirira aha biteekateeko by'abantu bingi
answer_c: Okureeba omuntu nk'ekintu ekirikukurira aha kuteeraho omutindo gw'emitwarize murungi.
answer_d: Okuteekateeka ngu okuhinduka kw'emitwarize kuruga omu biteekateeko by'omuntu.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa ari kukora omu kiraasi y'empisa aha biteekateeko by'obuhangwa bwa Aristotle. Nagambira abegi be kuha eby'okureeberaho by'ebikorwa nari embeera omuhandiirwe obuhangwa buriyo. Omwegi agira ati "omuntu orikushoma munonga aine obuhangwa nk'omuntu orikukora emizaano mingi." Ni enki aha bintu ebi omwegyesa araakore eky'okwemerereza omwegi kuteekateeka obuhinduka bwe kugyenda aha kwetegyereza okurikusiima obuhangwa bwa Aristotle?
answer_a: Omwegyesa omwegi ebirungi eby'omutima ebikuru.
answer_b: Omugyezibwa naabuuza omwegi kumushobororera eki arikwetegyereza aha kicweka ekirikukirayo oburungi
answer_c: Omugyezibwa naayamba omwegi kwijuka ngu okwetenga kw'omuntu nikukunda ebirungi
answer_d: Omugurusi naabuuza omwegi kuteekateeka yaaba abazani baine oburemeezi bw'okukora omupiira ogu barikukunda.

question: Omugyezaho ki ogu abaana b'eisomero erikuru baraakoresa ogu gunaabasaasisa kwetegyereza enshuraniso eri ahagati y'emitwarize erikukurata amateeka g'obuntu n'eri erikukurata amateeka g'abandi omu miterere y'empisa etari emwe?
answer_a: Omugyezibwa naahangaho ekicweka aha bbaoodi ekiine ebiteekateeko bikuru by'enteekateeka y'empisa eya Sartre ey'obuhangwa n'enteekateeka ya Kant.
answer_b: Omugurusi naakora kandi yashoborora abeeshuri maapu y'ebiteekateeko erimu ebiteekateeko by'emikorere ya Kant hamwe n'eya hedonistic, kurugiirira aha ntandikiro nari ebiragiro by'emitindo y'omuntu omwe.
answer_c: Omugyezibwa naabuuza abeeshuri kukora omukopi gw'ebitekerezo bikuru by'ebirikurugamu eby'emyemerero ya Aristotle na Kant, barikureeba omuhanda ogurikurugamu amateeka g'omuntu omwe.
answer_d: Omugyezibwa hamwe n'abeeshuli be nibakora akachati k'okuringaanisa kurugiirira aha bigyendererwa ebirondwa engyenderwka z'emitwarize ezirikugambwaho abarikukuratira oburyo bw'okweshemeza n'ab'Eristoiko

question: Omugyezibwa naayehangire omurimo omu mwaka gwa kana omuishomero erikuru ahabw'ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa ekirikukurataho: "Kutaana n'emiteekateeka aha kibazo ky'empisa z'abantu omuri obunaku obu." Ekibazo omwegyezibwa arikukora n'abegi nikikwata aha kuhandiika enshenga ezirikutaana aha by'abantu boona n'eby'omuntu omwe kurugiirira aha miteekateeka ya Arendt n'abandi abakuru omu by'amagezi, n'okubihuriira n'omuringo tekinologia ezikozesibwa omuri obunaku obu. Aha muheru gw'omurimo, nikiteekateekwa kucungura oku abegi batungiremu obwengye. Omu mirimo y'abegi erikukurataho, niki eki kirikworeka gye ngu ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa ekitungirweho?
answer_a: Nibamanyisa emiringo etari emwe n'emwe ey'obwengye n'etari ey'obwengye ey'okushoborora ebihingo by'abantu boona na by'omuntu omwe.
answer_b: Nibamanya ebiragiro ebirikushoborora emitererera yaabo aha bantu boona n'eby'omutaano omu bwire obu, nibareeba aha bi Eby'amagezi ebyakozirweho omu kiraasi
answer_c: Nibarikiriza ebi barikugambira hamwe n'ebi omwegi munabwe arikugamba aha nshonga y'enshoni z'abantu n'ez'ekyama omu kukoresa emikutu y'eby'omuntu, nibareeba aha bi abafilosofo barikukoresa omu kiraasi.
answer_d: Nibakora empaka aha mitegyeko y'obucureezi aha mitandao y'eby'omuby'abantu, nibakoresa ebi bateekateeka abafilizoofa ab'edda, ab'omuri obu bwire, nari ab'omuri obu bwire obw'omumaiso.

question: Omuhanda gw'okushwijuma, omwegyesa naabuuza abegyeshwa be kucweekereza orutonde lw'amateeka g'okuteekateeka kurungi Descartes yaabaire ayolesa omu "Discourse on the Method." Omu biteekateeko ebi orikuza kukuratira, niki ekirikwija kwolesa omugasho gw'omurimo ogwo n'okuhikaana n'ebirikwetegwa kwegwa?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza omurongo gw'amateeka g'omuringo ogwo
answer_b: Nibarikwenda kumanya ekirikureetera amateeka ago goona.
answer_c: Nibamanya buri kimwe aha biragiro ebiri omu muringo gwa Cartesian
answer_d: Nibashobora kushoborora enshuraniso eri ahagati y'amagara g'ebirikurugirira omu miteekateeko mirungi.

question:
Omugyezibwa w’omu mashomero ga secondary agakurire, omu ku butandika kwegyesa omutwe "Chile omu myaka ya hagati ey’ekyasha kya makumi abiri", acwireho kukoresa okubuuza ebizibu nk’omuringo gw’okushwijuma. Kuherize kworeka ebifaananyi by’ebyafaayo ebimwe ebirukukwata aha bagyenyi abari omu orurengo, omugyezibwa abuuza abegyi ekibuuzo ekirikukurataho: "Kwonka, kuruga omu myaka ya 1930, obulemi buba butungwire nibukora aha kutunguura embeera y’abantu kukendeeza obutahikiirira omu bantu, shi okureetaho ebishaka n’obugyenyi omu nguuto omuri Santiago nikushoboororwa kita?"
Ni mirimo ki erikuba eshobora kworekwa kurabira omu murimo ogurikushoboororwa?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza embeera z'obwahati ez'omutaano ezirikukomooka omu byaro omu myaka ya hagati omu kyasha kya makumi abiri.
answer_b: Nibarikiriza omikono gy'ebifo ebihendaine ebyabaire biri omu bwijwire bw'ekyasha kya makumi abiri.
answer_c: Nibarikira enshonga z’ebirikukurata omumaisho ahabw’ebirikukorwa kuruga omu gavumenti n’okukura kw’orurembo omu myaka makumi ataano ey’okubanza ey’ekyasha kya makumi abiri
answer_d: Nibarikira aha migaano y'obushangwa bw'obuhangwa n'enshonga ahabw'okutaho obwo bushangwa omu kicweka ky'okubanza ky'ekyasha kya makumi abiri.

question: Omwegyesereza naabo abari omu mwaka gwa 3 ogw'ahaiguru naabagira ngu omu mutwe "Okucwekyera kw'Obuteeka", ekigyendererwa ekirikukurirwa omu bibinja nikyo: "Kwetegyereza okucwekyera kw'obuteeka kurabira omu muringo ogurikureetera bingi". N'ahabw'ekyo, naabateekateeka ngu bashereeze ebimanyiso ebirikukwata aha bwire obwo omu nshuro ez'omutaano. Hanyuma, naashoboorora ngu kurugiirira aha bimanyiso ebi, omu bibinja, nibaija kugabana eki bashereize n'abandi omu kiraasi. Ekibiina kimwe nikibuuza omwegyesa yaaba kirungi kukora orutaro rwabo n'omurongo gw'ebiro gw'emyaka ya 1970-1973, nibahamya ebyabaho eby'omutaano n'eby'omuringo ogurikushushana. Omwegyesa, bwamara kubahurira, n'abateekateeka kushereeza omuringo gw'okurataho ogundi, ahabw'okuba omurimo ogurateirweho tigurikubasiisa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa ky'okwega eki baatooraine. Ahabw'enki omurongo gw'ebiro gutarikukwata aha kigyendererwa ky'okwega eki guteekateekirwe abegyesibwa?
answer_a: Ahabw’okuba nikusiima okucwamu kurugiirira omu muringo ogurikukurikirana, omu mwanya gw’okurugiirira omu ndengo nyingi ez’enjawulo
answer_b: Ahabw’okuba niry’ahukanisa ebyabaireho omu bwire bw’okubanza, omu mwanya gw’okutebeekanisa obukuru bwabyo.
answer_c: Ahabw’okuba kigumira okwetegyereza ebintu omu muringo oguhikire, omu mwanya gw’okwetegyereza engyenderwaho y’ebyafaayo
answer_d: Ahabw’okuba nikyorobiisa kutebeekanisiza ebyabaho, omu mwanya gw’okubiteera hamwe okurikukurata obunyakanya obutari bumwe oburikwetengwa omu muringo gw’eby’omutaano.

question: Abanyeshuri omuri kiraasi y'omwaka gwa 3 baine kushuuruura ebyafaayo by'Obwire Obuhya nk'oku byashuuruurwa omuhandiiki w'ebyafaayo Eric Hobsbawm, kuraba omu kubaka omurongo gw'obwire. Kugira ngu bakikore, omwegyesa akabahereza ebiragiro ebi: 'Shuuruura eicweka eririkushushana n'"ekyasha kya 19 kirikurenga" n'eicweka eririkushushana n'"ekyasha kya 20 kirikukyeeka".' Kwonka, ku yaashomesereize eby'okugarukamu, bingi bikaba bitahikire, nk'oku kirikworekwa omu ky'okureeberaho eki: Ni biteekateeko ki ebiriine kwegyezibwa abanyeshuri kugira ngu bahikiirize ekigyendererwa ky'omurimo ogu?
answer_a: Eky’omugasho n’obwire obukuru
answer_b: Okugyenderera hamu n'empiinduka
answer_c: Obwire bwa ira n'obwire oburikukuraine omu bitebyo
answer_d: Ebyahwereireho n'ebirarugamu

question: Ahabw’omuheru gw’eklassi erikukwata aha "Omukoro gw’Eikaaro," omwegyesa naakora okucungura kw’okubanza kumanya yaaba abegyi be baatunga obuhame bw’ebintu ebirikureeta enkyukyeho omu kwenda ekintu. N’ahabw’ekyo, omwegyesa naabashaba kutorana omu by’okureeberaho bingi okukoresa embeera egi omu magara gya butoosha. Eky’okureeberaho ki aha by’ahaansi ekirikuhikaana n’omurimo gw’omwegyi ogurikuhikaana n’ebyo omwegyesa arikwenda ngu omwegyi atungye?
answer_a: José: Emyaka ibiri eya shweire, nkaba ngura shoqora ez’amata aha kafooto k’ishomero, kwonka obu amateeka gaahindukire, hati ninyetenga kubigura owaabweru kandi nkabyeta mu nshaho yange
answer_b: Claudia: Omuhingu gwaizo twagendire omu sinema n'abanywani baitu, baitu ahabw'okuba tukahika nyuma, titukabaasa kutunga tiketi, n'ahabw'ekyo twacwireho kumara esente omu pizza n'emisandwiici
answer_c: Jacqueline: Omu bwiire bw'oruheru, tukatebeekanisiza kandi tukakodiisa ekibanja ky'okubazamu omupiira gw'ebigere omurundi gumwe omu saabiiti, n'ahabw'ekyo ninyenda okugira pesos 1,200 buri saabiiti.
answer_d: Ignacio: Okuhitsya omwaka oguhingwire, nkaba ngyenda ngyenda nsheenya sente zangye ez'okukozesa n'omugati aha bikwato by'omu alubamu, baitu hati nk'oku ntakikyenda alubamu, ndekireho sente ezo kubaasa kuzisheenya aha kintu ekindi.

question: Omuhendo gw'ekiguzi n'omulingo giguza ekintu, omulingo abantu abengi abakiguula, n'omulingo abantu abake baguula ekintu.
answer_a: Omusingi gw'obukeene
answer_b: Eteeka ry'okwetenga
answer_c: Eky'obureezi bw'ebintu
answer_d: Eky'okutaha omu

question: Omugyezibwa, bwamara kukora aha mutwe "Omuringo gw'Eteeka erikukuratirwa", naashoborora omuringo ogurikwija kumwemerera kumanya yaaba abeeshure be ab'omwaka gwa kana omu mashomero ga secondary baashoboirwe kwetegyereza emisingi egirikugumya Eteeka erikukuratirwa. Omu miringo ekurikukurataho, n'oguhe ogurikwija kumwemerera kukora obuhame kumanya yaaba ekigyendererwa kyahikiirirwe?
answer_a: Okugira kurugiirira aha buhanu, omurimo gw'eihanga omu kwerinda obuhangwa bw'ensi yaaryo.
answer_b: Nekyoreka n'ekicweka ky'amashaza kurugiirira omu mbeera y'amakuru ngu ab'obushoboorozi nibahikaana n'ebikorwa byabo
answer_c: Niki ekirikushobora kurondooza obujunaanizibwa bwa gavumenti okukuumira obuhunguzi bw'abantu boona
answer_d: N’okushoborora obukuru bw’okwetaba omu by’okutoorana omu kubumbaho eihanga

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa klasa ya kabiri n’abaana be aha by’obuhangwa bw’Abagriika n’Abaruumi, kandi nk’ekicweka ky’emirimo y’ekicweka, agabura abegyirizibwa omu bibinja, naaha buri kibinja kaadi erikukwata aha kicweka ekikuru eky’obuhangwa obu, nk’eky’okureeberaho: ekibuga ky’emizano, amateeka, obwombeki n’ebyamagamba, eby’obuhangwa, obwengye, orurimi, n’ebindi. Buri kibinja kishemereire kucweera aha kicweka eki baheebwa nibakoresa ebyahandiikirwe ebi omwegyesa yaabahaire kandi bareke kumanyisa ebintu ebirikubaasa kureebwa omu bintu by’eizooba eri n’ebitarikubaasa. Aha biteekateeko ki eky’okwegyesa ebyafaayo omwegyesa orikubaasa kuba naagenderera omu murimo ogu n’abegyirizibwa be?
answer_a: Obuhangaanwa
answer_b: Obuhame
answer_c: Eky'obuhinduzi n'okutunguuka
answer_d: Okugyenderera hamu n'empiinduka

question: Omwegyesereza ki ekirikukoresibwa kubi omu kuteekateeka ebyafaayo ekurikureebwa omu bigambo by'omwegi?
answer_a: Narikurata ebintu by'obuganda bw'Abagriika arikwohereza oburyo oburikushisha amahanga.
answer_b: Arikiriza omushorongo gw'abantu omu Bugiriki n'ogw'Abarooma.
answer_c: Atafaayo omurage gw'omuco gw'Abagereeki ahabw'ebihangwa eby'iriho
answer_d: N'ayombeka ebintu by'omu bwojo bw'Abagriika arikukoresa emitwarize y'obu obu.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesi omu omurundi gwa kana abegyi omu tubiina, yaabahiga kushaka amakuru aha mukura gw'omunshaho (Internet) ahari eby'obugagga eby'obutonde ebya Chile. Obwo, yaabahiga kuganira aha bukuru bw'eby'obugagga ebi, kiki ekyaraabaho byaba biremire, n'omuringo ki tusobora kubirinda obwahati. Obuhikiiriza, buli kabiina kaseemereire kworeka eby'okumalirra byabo omu kiraasi. Obwomeezi ki omwegyesi arikusemerera kukuza okuraba omu murimo ogu?
answer_a: Okubuuza
answer_b: Okuteekateeka omu mwanya
answer_c: Okukora n'ebirikukuratirwa
answer_d: Okuteekateeka omuhendo

question:
Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'ekicweka kya 3 okutandika omutwe ogurikukwata aha Bugriika arikwatanisa abegi be n'embeera y'obuhangwa omu bw'ensi ahu obwo bwomeezi bwateerereize hamwe n'okucweekereza omugasho ogu bwaagira aha Bugriika.
Maapu ya ki eyabaasa kukora gye munonga aha kigyendererwa eki omwegyesa ataireho?
answer_a: Eby'omubiri
answer_b: Eby'obufuzi
answer_c: Eby'obushomesha n'eby'obugaiga
answer_d: Eihindagizo y'obwire

question: Omwegyesi w’ekicweka kya kindagateni naija kushwijuma ekigyendererwa ky’okwegyesa ekirikukurataho kuruga omu mutwe gw’ebintu ebirikukwata aha bantu n’obuhangwa: “Kushwijuma ebikoreso by’omu maka n’eby’obuhangwa bw’omulembe ebirikukoresibwa buri izooba nk’ebibya, ebintu ebirimu amatafaari, enfuka, ebijiko, amasimu, n’ebindi, arikubikoresa butoosha omu mbeera za buri izooba n’omumizaano.” Ni muringo ki ogurikworeka ngu ekigyendererwa eki kyahikiirirweho?
answer_a: Taaha amagama g'ebintu by'eteknologiija nk'essimu na saa.
answer_b: Koresa ebintu ebirikukoresibwa omu ka nk'ekikopo n'omuchaara, okushamba eby'okurya.
answer_c: Kukora aha, kuhuraho, hamu n'okukora ebiragiro n'ebintu ebirikukoresibwa omu ka, nk'ebbakuli n'ebikopo
answer_d: Tebeekanisa ebintu by'eteknologiya, nk'essimu n'endala, omuhanda gw'okubitebeekanisa omuhikirire.

question: Omuhereza omu kicweka ky'abaana bato aryakoresa ebi arikworeka nk'ekikoreso ky'okushwijuma okwega kw'abaana bato kurugiirira aha birikumanyisa by'omutwe gw'okwetegyereza embeera y'abantu n'obuhangwa: Agamba aha bikorwa bya butoosha eby'omukitongole kyabo. Nashoboorora okwetaba kwabo omu bikorwa bya butoosha eby'omukitongole kyabo. Ni bwihuriro ki bw'okwega oburaabe bukwatireire okureeba kushobora kwemeza ebi abaana bashoboirweho kurugiirira aha birikumanyisa ebi?
answer_a: Yozaho emirimo erikukorwa omu itungo ry'ebishuli.
answer_b: Gamba omu omu aha izooba ery'okuruhuuka eki baakozireyo.
answer_c: Muri twikundi tucure-ture, kwegyerereza ebikorwa bya buri izooba ebi bakora omu maka gaabo
answer_d: Omu mikutu, muganiire aha mirimo ab'eka barikukora omu mikoro.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesi w’ekicweka kya kashatu omu kucungura okumanya, akagambira ngu n’obu abegyesi be barikumanya kurungi okushoma n’okwetegyereza, niboreka oburemeezi omu kuzaana n’okuhakanira aha biteekerezo byabo. Ahabw’ekyo, omwegyesi naija kutebeekanisiza omurimo ogurikwija kugasira abegyesi kuteeraho omulingo gwabo. Omu mirimo ei erikukurataho, n’oguhe ogurikubaasa kukora eki ekigendererwa?
answer_a: Omugurusi n'abanyeshuri be nibakora hamwe akatabo kaine emiringo etari emwe y'okuteekateeka, obuhangwa bw'ebigambo, n'obushobezi, naashoboorora omuringo bashemereire kukoresa ebi bintu omu kuhandiika kwabo.
answer_b: Omugyezaho naakora ebibiina by'okuganiira aha miterere y'obwengye nk'omugyezaho gw'okuteekateeka. Bwanyima, abeeshuri baine kukora okuteekateeka kwabo nk'oku barikwetenga.
answer_c: Omugurusi naashaba abegi kushanga ekibarukirizi eky’empaka aha mukura gw’omunsi yoona (web) reero bakakora empaka zaabo nk’omuntu omweho aha muteekateeki ogurikukuratirwa omu kabooki akabaheebwa.
answer_d: Omugyezibwa naagambira abeeshuri kushoma "ebaruha eyaheerezebwa omu muhairwe w'ebitungo" kandi bagyobuniremu ebi erukwataho. Bwanyima, bashemereire kukora ebaruha yaabo abaheereza omu muhairwe w'ebitungo, nibahakanira ebi barukwetenga.

question: Omugyezibwa omu omuhiga omu mwaka gwa kana omu ishomero erikuru ari kukora aha mutwe gw'enyegyesa y'Emitwarize Mirungi. Ekigyendererwa ky'eklassi n'okureetera abegi kumanya emitindo y'obulemi eyahandiikirwe omu bwire bw'aha ira. Kuti ekihikiirizibwe, abaha obucweka kuruga omu kitabo kya Plato ekya Republica, kandi abashaba kurugyayo hamu n'okushoboorora emitindo y'obulemi eyagambwaho. Omu bwire bw'omurimo ogwo, ekibiina ky'abegi nikiganiira aha nshonga egi: shi obulemi bw'abantu bwaba nibutwarwa nk'obumu aha mitindo mirungi y'obulemi, ahabwaki Plato nabushoboorora nk'omutindo gw'obulemi ogurikushwekyereza? Bwanyima babuuza omwegyesa kubahwera kukora aha kizibu eki. Kurugiira aha mbeera eyo, niki eki omwegyesa araakore kumwegyereza abegi hamu n'okumaraho ekibuuzo kyabo?
answer_a: Naabuuza kugaragura gavumenti y'obuteegyeki bw'ekigangaanzi na gavumenti ya demokarasi, bashuuruure enshaanju, reero bakorese omuringo ogwa Plato.
answer_b: N’omuhereza ekikaguzo ky’abeeshuri nk’omugisha gw’okucungura omu biteekateeko bya Plato eby’obulemi bw’omutaano kandi agyeringanise n’emitindo y’obulemi eriho hati.
answer_c: Naashoboorora ngu gavumenti z'omuri obu bwire tizirikubaasa kuhikaana n'ebirikushoboororwa bya Plato aha gavumenti ahabw'obuzibu bwingi obw'emitwarize yazo ezi zirikukoresa omu bwire obu.
answer_d: Naabingiiza kushuuma omuringo Plato yaashobooroirwe demokarasi, reero hamwe nabo, bagyeragyeranisa ebi Plato yaabaire naateekateeka n'omuringo orikukoresibwa obu demokarasi.

question: Omwegyesereza n'omwegyesi ari kukora omutwe gw'empisa omu kiraasi y'omwaka gwa kana gw'ahaiguru kandi omu kwegyesa okurikukuraho naija kugarukamu ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa ekirikukuraho: "Kukora ebirooto by'omuntu aha muntu, kuronda n'okubuza ebiri omusingi gw'abandiki." Omu kicweka kya bwambere eky'ekiro, omwegyesi naija kushobororera abegyesi emiteekateeka y'abantu nk'oku Hobbes na Rousseau bagishoboroire kandi atebeekanise omurimo ogurikukuraho ogurikwija kuleetera abegyesi kwetaba omu by'omunda ebi kandi bahikiirize ekigyendererwa. Aha mirimo ei erikukuraho, niki ekirikubaasa kuba ekirikwetenga abegyesi kugira ngu bagarukemu ekigyendererwa ekirikugambwaho?
answer_a: Abeshomesha nibaha orugyero omu maisho g'abanywani baabo, nibarikworeka eby'okureeberaho by'amagara ga buri izooba ebirikworeka emitwarize y'abantu omu mbeera y'obutaremeeza nk'oku Hobbes na Rousseau baagigambire.
answer_b: Abeshomesha nibakora omuzano ogurikugambisa ogubarikwesire kucwamu yaaba bakuratire engyenderwka y'abantu nk'oku Hobbes yaagiteekateeka nari Rousseau, kubaasa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa.
answer_c: Abeshomesha nibakora okuteerana omu meza y'omuzinga nibagamba aha nshonga y'okubba omu maduuka, nibahakanisa kurugiirira aha misingye y'eby'abantu eya Hobbes na Rousseau
answer_d: Abeshomesha nibarikwohereza omuhazyo gw'empaka z'emitwarize murimu okucwamu eky'okukuratira, kwaba okureeberera ebirikusangwaisa abakozi nari omukama waabo, nibahamirira kuruga aha miteekateeko y'abantu nk'oku Hobbes na Rousseau baagiteekateeka.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa ari kushwijuma ebicweka bitari bimwe kuruga omu bitabo by'abafilósofa n'abanyeshuri b'omu mwaka gwa ikumi na ibiri, omuri bo harimu Nietzsche na Sartre. Omunyeshuri abuuza yaaba hariho omukago gwona oguri hagati y'ekigambo kya Nietzsche: "Ruhanga afiire" n'okutinya okw'amaani okurikukurwa omu biteekateeko by'obuhangwa nk'oku Sartre arikugamba. Eky'okugarukamu ki aha bigambo ebi erikushoboorora okutari kumanya kw'omunyeshuri n'obuhangwa oburikukwata aha biteekateeko n'obuhangwa obuhikire?
answer_a: Eego, obuhangwa buriyo, ahabw’okuba enyegyesa ya Sartre eruga omu ebyo abafilosofo nk’aba Nietzsche baayorekireho enyima.
answer_b: Eego, obuhangwa nibwo buriho, ahabw'okuba byombi nibihikaana n'emiteekateeko y'obufirosoofi erikubuza ebyo abantu baraabe barikumaraireho nibashobora nk'ebihikire.
answer_c: Eego, hariho akakwataniso, ahabw'okuba ebigambo "Ruhanga afiire" n'okutenga emitima nibyo byombiriri birikworeka obwetengyeerwa nari obugabe bw'abantu omu by'emiteekateeka omu kubaha Ruhanga, okucwamu n'okukora ebirungi nari ebibi.
answer_d: Eego, nibarikwatagana, ahabw'okuba abaandiki boona nibateekateeka aha mbeera y'omuntu omu maisho g'okubaho, n'oburemeezi n'obuhangwa bw'oburemeezi bw'obuhabuzi bw'empisa okwebembera ebi omuntu arikukora, ebirikuba eby'akabi hatariho biragiro by'Obuhangwa nari eby'omugasho.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’omu mwaka ogw’ana owa siniya yaaba ashobooroire okucuumuura kwa Kant aha bushobozi bw’okumanya, reero yaabuuza abegyi be kumugarukamu ebibuuzo ebiriho obuhangwa omu bbitabo byabo. Ku yaareebiremu, yaashanga omwingi gw’eklassi bagwire aha by’okugarukamu bya Kant aha kintu ekirikwetegyerezebwa n’endengo y’abantu abarikukuratira okumanya okurikuruga omu kumanya kw’ebintu. Murimo ki oguraabe gubwire gubaire gubasa abegyi kwetegyereza n’okutaanisa ebi Kant arikuteekateeka?
answer_a: Abaana bashomesa omuringo gw'okuteekateeka ogw'abantu abarikukuratira amagezi g'okukuratira ebirooto n'okuteekateeka kwa Kant, nibabihandiika omu bitabo byabo.
answer_b: Abeshomesha nibakora okunoonyereza aha biteekerezo bya Kant na Locke, bwanyima babanjura eby'omugasho ebirukirayo.
answer_c: Abeshomesha nibakora okushushanisa omu biteekateeko by'abantu abarikwikiriza ngu okumanya kuruga omu kumanya ebintu (empiricists), abarikwikiriza ngu okumanya kuruga omu bwengye (rationalists), na biteekateeko bya Kant, kuraba omu maapu y'ebiteekateeko.
answer_d: Abeshomesha nibahanga emiramwa y'ebigambo eya Kant, abarikwesiga obwengye n'abarikukuratira amagezi.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’omwaka ogwa kana owa siniya yaaba nayetebeekaniza ekigyendererwa ky’abeesikuru be okucweekamu n’okushoboorora ebigambo bya Nietzsche ebigira ngu "tihariho mazima, kureka okushoboorora kyonka", ahabw’ekyo yaacwireho kukoresa ebikoreso kuruga omu byamumaisho by’abantu boona. Ebintu ebiri aha hansi aha nibiri haihi n’okukora aha kigyendererwa eki?
answer_a:
Eky'obushuba: Abashomesa nibeehanangiriza omushahara omwingi kuruta abagurusi b'eishomero

Eky'okuhakanisa ekyo: Ekitongore ekirikukora aha mishahara kyashoborora ngu abashomesa nibafuna omushahara ogurikuringana n'oburemeezi bw'omulimo gwabo n'obuhangwa bwabo, kandi ngu tibarikufuna mwingi kuruta abagurusi b'eishomero.
answer_b: Yoreka ebishushani ebirungirwe n'ebyo ebitarungirwe by'abantu abarikurugamu omuri televizoni
answer_c: Tungyezayo ebitebe by'amawulire bibiri ebirikworeka ekintu kimwe kwonka omu miringo erikushangaanisibwa n'abantu abarikuhandiika amakuru.
answer_d: Yoreka omuhendo gw'abantu abakunzi n'abatakunzi ekishushani ekirikukwata aha mafaayo g'ebirikubaho.

question: Omugyezaho akashomesa omutwe gw'ebyeshururu aha by'okumanya omu mwaka gwa 3 ogw'eshuri ya secondary, naasinga kwikiriza aha nshonga za Descartes ezirikukwata aha kintu. Omu kucungura, akareeba ngu abamwe aha banyeshuri nibashoborora enshonga ezirikukwata aha biteekateeko by'obuhikiriire nk'ebi: "Kurugiirira ahari Descartes, abantu boona ku barikugira ekiteekateeko ky'obuhikiriire buri, nikubaa n'ahabw'okuba twena twabaire twine obumanyiso bw'ekintu ekihikiriire, kandi n'ahabw'ekyo ekiteekateeko eki kikaba kishuuruurirwe omu biteekateeko byaitu. Kandi twena ku twabaire tumanyire ekintu ekihikiriire, nikubaa n'ahabw'okuba Ruhanga akahanga ebintu ebi." Kurugiirira aha nshonga za Cartesian, buzibu ki omu muringo gw'okwega oburikubaasa kumanywa kuruga omu kagaruko aka?
answer_a: Abeshomesha tibarikirize kucweeka ekizibu kya Cartesian ekirikukwata aha kintu ekihikire ekirikuruga omu biteekateeko byaitu
answer_b: Abeshomesha tibarikwetegyereza eky'okuranga kya Descartes aha biteekateeko by'obuhikiriire nk'ekiteekateeko eky'omunda ekirikuruga omu bwengye.
answer_c: Abeshuri tibarikirize gushobora kurondora ebiragiro byabo omu muringo ogurikwihiriza, nibagumisiriza kurondora eky'okurorraho kya Cartesian aha biteekateeko bya Ruhanga ebirikuruga omu kuhikiirira.
answer_d: Abeshomesha tibarikoziremu kutebeekanisa omukurikirane gw'okujurira gwoona kuruga omu kujurira kwa Descartes okurikugira ngu Ruhanga abaho kuruga omu biteekateeko by'okuhikiirira.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa siniya eya kana okushoboorora enyegyesa ya Plato aha by'obufuzi, kandi ahabw'ekyo aine kwetegyereza yaaba abegyi baine obumanyi oburikwetagisa. Ni nshonga ki eya Plato abegyi baine kumanya kubaasa kwetegyereza omuhanda Plato arikuteekateeka aha gavumenti?
answer_a: Emitwaro y'emyoyo
answer_b: Obwomeezi bwa Plató obw'ebiri
answer_c: Enyegyeso y'ebiteekateeko
answer_d: Ebirungi by'obutebenesi

question:
Omugyezibwa naayegyesa omuri yuniti y'Ebyemanyiso omu mwaka gwa 3 ogw'eshomero erikuru n'abegi be, kandi nk'omurimo gw'okukora aha kiragiro eki: "Kwetegyereza entandikiro y'obwomeezi bw'abantu", nibateekateeka kushoma n'okushoboorora Okuteekateeka kw'Okubanza okwa Descartes okw'Eby'omubiri.
Ni ebiha ebi abegi bashemereire kuba barayegire obuto kubaasa kukora aha kiragiro ky'ekicweka?
answer_a: Ebirimo by'okuteekateeka n'okukozesa ebirowoozo n'ebimanyiso ebirikumanyisa.
answer_b: Amakuru g'obuhangwa bwa "axiology" na "epistemology"
answer_c: Ebirimo bya Tabula Rasa n'ebiteekateeko
answer_d: Emizimu y'ebihara n'akaganga k'obwonko

question:
Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'ekumi na ibiri, omu mutwe gw'enyegyesa y'empisa, naija kukorera hamwe n'abegyi be aha biteekateeko by'okucwamu empisa nk'oku Spinoza yaabiteekateekire.
Ni ki eki abegyi bashemereire kuba bamaze kwega kuruga owa Spinoza kubaasa kwetegyereza okucwamu kwe empisa nk'oku yaabiteekateekire?
answer_a: Amagara ag'obuntu
answer_b: Embeera z'obuntu ez'omusingi
answer_c: Okugonza kw'amagezi
answer_d: Enyamutima egiirikukora

question: Omugyezibwa naayehereza omwegyesa okushobora omutindo gw'ebicweka by'omugyeranizo, ebyakozirwe abegyeshwa b'omwaka gwa kana omu mashomero agari haihi, aha biteekateeko bya Descartes na Locke. Ekigyendererwa ky'omurimo gukaba kyakushobora no'kugyeranisa oburemeezi bw'okumanya omu bahandiiki bombi. Omu murimo gumwe, nikireebwa ngu abegyeshwa nibahereza ebi bateekateeka ebirikukwatana n'abahandiiki, beitu okugyeranisa hagati yabo tikurikukorwa. Ni ki aha bigambwa ebi ekirikuhereza amakuru g'omutindo kandi kikaragira abegyeshwa omu muringo ogurikwenda okuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa?
answer_a: Emihere erikwetwa nibihikire kandi birungi, kwonka nibyetenga kutebeekanisibwa omu mitwarize mirungi kwongyera kukora gye.
answer_b: Amakuru g'omuhandiiki weena nigwo mazima. Tikurikukwatanisa omu muringo ogurikukurirana n'ebibuuzo nari ebiteekateeko ebiri hamwe, kwonka eby'okugarukamu n'amanyisio ebirikumaraire, okukora omuringo murungi gw'okugyeragyeranisa.
answer_c: Omurimo murungi. Kwonka, okuhwereera okugyeragyeranisa, nikyetaagisa kukihindura omu muringo ogurikugumiisiriza okwetegyereza kw'abahangaabo buli omwe.
answer_d: Ebirango by'abandiiki boona nibimanywa gye. Hati, okukora okugyeragyeranisa okurikukwata, nikikuru kutebeekanisa ebi biteekerezo n'obwegendereza oburikukiraho omu by'okuhakanisa.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa sekenda, omu mutwe gw'ebizibu by'okubaho, naija kucweekereza ekigyendererwa eki: “Okukoresa omu muringo ogw'obucureezi n'okwetegyereza ekiteekateeko kya Heidegger ekikwata aha kubaho okutari okw'amazima.” Ni bintu ki ebiraabe by'omugasho okworeka okuhingura kw'ebyo omwegi yaayegire ebikwata aha kigyendererwa eki?
