answer_a: Teegeka enteekateeko ya wiiki y'ebikorwa bya buri izooba erikworeka embeera y'amagara ey'oburyarya
answer_b: Taaha emiteekateeka y'omutwe erimu ebintu bishatu ebiriho ebirikureetera omuntu kutunga amagara g'obushuba
answer_c: Teeranire hamwe ebipande by'omu mpapula z'amawulire n'ebyarabire omu magaziini ebirikworeka amagara g'obushuba.
answer_d: Orwandiiko rw'okuhamya ahari enkora y'omuca ekuteeraho amagara agatarimu amazima

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Omugyezibwa naaba naakora n’abanyeshuri b’omwaka gwakabiri omuri sekenda aha mutwe “Okugumya Obulemi n’Obutegyeki bw’abantu boona omuri Chile omu kicweka kya mbere ky’ekyasha kya 20”. Kuguza abaana obwo bakwetegyereza omulingo ogw’okutandika ekibiina kya Popular Front omuri Chile, abagambira kweteraanira hamwe n’abanyeshuri bagenzi baabo bataano, baroondemu ekibiina kimwe eky’obulemi ekya center-left ekyabaireho omuri Chile omwaka gwa 1937 (abashosialisti, abakoministi, abaradikaali, n’abanaakisti) kandi kuruga omu bitabo ebi bakozireho omu mashomo agahweire, bagarukemu ekikaguzo ekirikukurataho: “Ahabw’enki ekibiina kyakwegaita aha Popular Front?”. Hanyuma abagambira kureebya nk’ekitebe ky’abegaita hamwe ahu buli kibinja ky’abakozi kirikworeka enshonga ahabw’enki ekibiina ky’obufuzi kyakwegaita nari kitakwegaita aha Popular Front. Nooreba ekitundu kya kabiri eky’omulimo ogu, ni miko gurihe ogurikubaasika kuguzibwa?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza embeera eya Fronti Eyakunzi eyabahoiremu
answer_b: Nibarikwenda ebirooto ebyabaire nibihindura omuhanda gw'ekibiina kya Popular Front
answer_c: Nibarikira aha misingye y'ebirikukiriraho eya Popular Front
answer_d: Nibarikiriza ensonga ezireetera okutandikwa kw'Ekibiina kya Popular Front

question: Omugyezibwa omwegyesa w’omu mwaka gwa kabiri ogw’eshomero erikuru, omu mutwe Kuruga omu Nsi Etaine Emihanda Ebiri okuhika omu Nsi Yoona: Eryariro Enyerere, aine ekigyendererwa ky’okukora aha kigendererwa eki: “Kutaanura empindahinduka nkuru ez’eby’obutegyeki n’ensi yona bwanyima y’okuhwaho kw’Eryariro Enyerere”, omu bwengye bw’eby’amateeka obw’okuteekateeka eby’ebyafaayo. Okukora eki, omwegyesa aha abegi emeeta ibiri z’Erope, emwe kuruga omu myaka ya 1960 n’endiiyo kuruga omu mwaka gwa 2000, n’abagambira kushoboorora ebintu bishatu ebiri nk’ebimwe n’ebintu bishatu ebirikutaana omu by’obutegyeki n’ensi yona. Ni nshonga ki y’obwengye bw’eby’amateeka oburikugambwaho omu murimo ogwo?
answer_a: Shuuruura ebyabaho eby’omutaano omu bwire n’omu mwanya
answer_b: Yoreka omulingo ebintu byahindukire omu byafaayo omu bwire oburahingwire
answer_c: Shuuruura omukago hagati y'ebipimo ebirukiraine n'ebicweka by'obunene ebirukiraine omu by'okurorraho by'abantu
answer_d: Yetegyere ngu ebyafaayo omuntu akabihanga kandi nibikura omu bwire n'omu mwanya.

question: Ni ebiki aha binu ebikurikiyo nibyo birahwera abeeshomesa abari omu mwaka ogwa kana kwetegyereza enshuraniso eri ahagati y'ekifo ekirikushobora n'ekihamire ky'ebintu omu bwangaani nari omu maapu?
answer_a: Omuri buri omwe, abeegi nibashobora kushobora endengo ezirikukurirana n'ebintu bitari bimwe na bimwe ebirikushushanisibwa aha kagiridi k'endengo reero bashobore n'okushobora omwanya gw'ebintu ebyo bimwe kurugiirira aha biri haihi. Muheru, nibagyeragyeranisa emyanya yoona n'okugaba ebirikukurira.
answer_b: Omu omwe na mugyenzi we, omwegi omwe ashushaniisa ekintu aha katiba k'ebibarizo, arikukiteeka omu mwanya kurugiirira n'ebirikuragirwa mugyenzi we. Bwanyima, bahindurana emirimo bakore eki kimwe. Obu barikumariiriza, bagyeranisiza omumyanya n'okugaba ebi barikwega.
answer_c: Omuri babiri babiri, omwegi omwe aha omwegi ondiijo ebiragiro kurugiira aha katabo k'omuko ogurikwegamira aha muko ogundi (coordinate grid) kutunga emeeza erikwetwa omu kicweka. Bwanyima, bashwijuma yaaba omwanya gw'emeeza aha katabo k'omuko niguhikaanira n'omwanya gw'emeeza omu mazima kandi bagabane ebirugiremu.
answer_d: Omwe omwe, abeegi nibashobora kushoborora omuhanda gw'okugyenda omu myanya etari emwe kurugiirira aha maapu ekubirwe aha kagiridi k'omukozi (coordinate grid) erimu akamwenyu k'omuyaga (compass rose), reero bagyeragyeranise kandi bagambiraneho n'eklassi.

question: Omu omwegyesa omu kiraasi ky'abataano, naakora n'abegyi be aha mugyenderezo gw'okwegyesa ogurikukurataho: "Kukora okucwekyereza, kushoborora, n'okushanga obuzibu obw'obutonde oburikukwata aha itungo ei barikugambira, nk'emisisi, tsunamis, ebigyira, ebiteeko, n'ebirunga." Hamwe n'eki, ekigyendererwa n'okugumya okukura kw'okuteekateeka kw'eby'obutaka, nikwo kugira ngu obushoboorozi bw'okureeba n'okumanya emikago mingi ei abantu barikutaaho hagati yabo n'obutonde, nibakora omwoyo gw'okurinda obutonde omu bategyezi. Aha mirimo ei erikukurataho, niki ekirikubaasa kureetera okukura kw'okuteekateeka kw'eby'obutaka n'okukwata aha mugyenderezo oguteirweho?
answer_a: Abeshomesha nibategyeka emiringo etari emwe y'akabi aka butonde oburikubaho omu kitundu kyabo, kurugiirira aha bunene bw'ekitundu obu burikukwataho, nibashobora kumanya embeera ezirikushushana.
answer_b: Abeshomesha nibakora maapu y'ekitundu kyabo barikworeka obuzibu bw'obutonde eburikubaireho omu myaka ehiherize omu kitundu kyabo
answer_c: Abaana bashobora kushoborora akabi k'obutonde obwabaireho omu kitundu kyabo, nibashoborora ebikareeta, emigumaho yabyo aha bantu, hamwe n'ebikorwa ebi bisobora kukorwa kucwera oburemeezi.
answer_d: Abaana bashoora omu kabi k'obutonde akarikubaho omu kitundu kyabo, nibarikwoleka ekika kyako, emitwarize yaako mikuru, n'omurundi gwangahi kararugireho omu myakagana ekumi ehwaire.

question: Omugyezibwa naayegyesa aha ntandikiro y'obugomi bwa 1973 n'abegi be ab'omumwaka gwa mukaaga. Omwe ahagati omu naamushengura kumubuuza ebi: "Mwegyesa, tindikwetegyereza obu orikutugambira: 'embeera egi ekaba enshonga y'Obugomi ahabw'omukopi w'ebyafaayo ogu, kwonka tikwo ahabw'ogundi.' N'ahabw'ekyo, Abanyamerika bakaba baine amaani maingi aha bugomi bwa 1973? Ego nari ingaha?". Ni nshobya ki ey'okwetegyereza eby'afaayo, nk'eshomo, erikubaasa kukurugamu omu kibuuzo ky'omwegi?
answer_a: Okucweekereza eby'afaayo omu maani g'obureeberera ensi omuhanda gw'okugyenda.
answer_b: Okutwariramu ebyefugo omu byafaayo
answer_c: Okuteekateeka eby'afaayo nk'eky'okubuurira ebyahwereireho omu muringo ogutari gw'okushisha
answer_d: Okugyenda omu kubanza kw'ekintu kimwe kuruga omu byafaayo

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'eky'omushanju yaaza kushuuruura yaaba abegyeshwa be "Nibashobora kushoborora empinduka ezarugire omu kucangaanura kw'Obuhangwa bwa Neolithic omu mukago gw'abantu n'obuzingirire kuraba omu kwetegyereza obuhanga bw'ebintu." Ni bintu ki ebiri ahansi ebi birikubaasa kwiikiriza omwegyesa kukora obuhanga bw'okushuuruura ebirikumanyisa okuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki kirikwolekwa?
answer_a: Shaba abeshomesa batoore eby'okuruga omu mitwaro ya intaneeti ebikwata aha muringo gw'Obunyasiriti, kandi babishoboorore.
answer_b: Shaba abeeshuri bakore omu bubiri bubiri bashwijume ebintu ebirikukwata aha mpinduka y'Obunyakura (Neolithic revolution) reero bohereze ebicweka bikuru bya buri kimwe.
answer_c: Mugambire abeeshuli kukora omu bubiri bubiri kwijuza eshaati aha nshaijaana n'okushushana kw'ebisibo bibiri ebikwatiraine n'entebeekanisa y'eby'obufuzi n'embeera z'abantu eyaashimweireho omu bwire bwa Neolithic
answer_d: Orikiriza abaana kwandiika omwandiko gw'okuteekateeka gwena gwena aha nkyukakyuuka ezaareetsirweho emirimo y'okubyara n'okutunga omu bwire bwa Neolithic kurugiirira aha nshuro ez'omutaano.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’ekicweka kya mushanju ari kukora omutwe gw’okutandika kw’obugabe bw’okubanza. Omu emwe aha kiraasi, ekigyendererwa nikigambwaho: “Kwetegyereza entebeekanisa y’eby’obufuzi y’e Misiri ey’edda.” Kimwe aha bikorwa ebiragizibwe abeeshuri n’okushoma obuhanga bw’amashomo ahari oku obushoboorozi bw’eby’obufuzi bw’omwami wa Misiri bwaabaire butebeekanisibwe, kwonka kushingamira aha kigyendererwa ekiragizibwe. Ebikorwa ebiri aha bwomeezi nibyo birikworeka okuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa abeeshuri?
answer_a: Nibarikira omuringo gw'okwegatta kw'obugabe bwa Misiri, ekyahwereire aha gavumenti nkuru kugumaho.
answer_b: Nibarikwenda omuringo gw’okutebeekanisa ab’amaani munonga omu bwami, abatooraine omukuru omuri bo kwegyira obushoboorozi.
answer_c: Nibamanya ebikorwa by'abagyereza, abarikukoresa amaani g'omukama kugira ngu baayombeke emp пирамиды kandi baramye banyamahanga baabo
answer_d: Nibashoborra kushoborra oku okutahirira abantu abandi, ahabw'okutunga eitaka ry'omugyera Nile, kwaretereire okwiimukira aha bwesigwa bw'omukungu orikukirra abandi, owaashoboirwe kubahindura.

question: Omwegyesereza ki omwegyesa w’ekicumi na munaana ari kukora aha kicweka ‘Okukura kw’Obwami bw’Amahanga,’ arikugyenderera kuteza omuhanda obwengye bw’okushoma n’okucwamu ebiri omu bitabo, okukiraho obwesigwa bw’ebitabo, arikureeba aha maani agahengwa aha kuteza omuhanda okuteekateeka kw’ebyafaayo. N’ekigyendererwa eki, nashaba okushoma ekitabo ekirikukurataho: Tariho omuntu orikubaasa kukaana ngu amaani [...] g’abami gakuzire ahabw’okuba eby’obushoboorozi by’eby’entaasi n’obunene bw’engabo byeyongyeire. Kandi, ebiragiro tibirikurinda abantu bonka kureka n’amaani g’abakuru. Abamanyaamateeka bakaba bari kimwe aha bintu bikuru eby’okuhindura obwami. Kandi eki kikaba kiri kikuru omu mahanga agu obukugu bw’amateeka [...] buraazire omu mateeka g’abaroma ab’enyima [...] (Yuropa y’Okuhindura. 1517 - 1559, Elton Geoffrey (1999).) Ni murimo ki ogurikwija kuteza omuhanda okucwamu obwesigwa bw’ekitabo abeeshuri?
answer_a: Gambura omutwarize gw'enshuro, ya bwambere nari ya kabiri, kurugiira aha mwaka gw'okucapirwa.
answer_b: Shisha Elton Geoffrey orihi kandi ekigyendererwa kye kikaba kiri ki obu yaabaire naahandiika ebyahandiikirwe ebi?
answer_c: Shobora omumanyisa omuteekateeki omukuru omu byafaayo arikukwata aha b'obwami omu mahanga
answer_d: Shobora ekirikukwata aha maani g'omugabe niki kyakugasa omu kwetegyereza okukura kw'obugabe bw'ihanga?

question: Omu omwegyesa omu klasse y’ahaiguru ey’omwaka gwa kashatu, ari kukora aha mutwe gw’okwegyera ogurikukwata aha Kumanya, Saayansi, n’Amazima, okukiraho okwetegyereza enshuraniso ya Hume aha bikurikurebwa n’ebirikuteekateekwa nk’enshuro z’okumanya. question: Omwegyesereza omugabe omu 2 omu omutwe gw'ebyafaayo, omu omutwe "Ensi Etaine Ebiri", naija kucweeza ekigyendererwa ky'eklassi ekirikukurataho: "Kushoborora ebiragiro by'eby'obufuzi n'endimi z'Amerika na Soviet Union omu bwire bw'olutalo orw'obutaho," omu kwikirizana n'obwegendereza bw'eby'okwegyesa by'eby'obushomesha: okureeba eby'obufuzi n'eby'obushubuzi. Noorekire ebigambo ebirikugambwaho, niki aha mirimo erikukurataho ey'abegi kukora ekirikukwatana n'ekigyendererwa ky'eklassi n'obwegendereza bw'eby'okwegyesa oburikugambwaho?
answer_a: Noboona omu interneti aha bikwatiraine n'okukuratira engyenderwera y'eby'obushomesha y'Amerika na Soviet Union n'omugasho gwabyo omu by'obufuzi, orikureeba aha bubasha bwa buri emwe omu kasumi k'olutalo orutakonaga, reero ohandiike omutwe gw'ekiganiiro ahari ekyo.
answer_b: Teeka ekishushani ekirikworeka ebintu by'omutaano ebyabaireho omu by'obusiima n'eby'obushubuzi omu bigyendererwa by'obuteegyeki bya Amerika na Soviet Union, reero oshoboorore omu kamutwe akagufu oku buri kimwe kyaagyeendereizeho omu bwire bw'Entaro Enkonye.
answer_c: Shoma ebyahandiikirwe ebirikukwata aha ngyenderweso za Amerika na Soviet Union omu bwire bw'olutalo orw'obutaho, reero ohandiike ebirikukurugamu ebikwata aha bitegyeki byabo ebikuru n'omusingi gw'entebeekanisa y'eby'obushangwa, oronde ebintu birungi n'ebibi ebya buri ngyendereso.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa ari kutebeekaniza kukora ebikorwa bishatu by'omukurikiraano, arikukoresa obuhame, ngu abegi be ab'omwaka gwakabiri omuishomero erikuru bashobore kwetegyereza obuzigu bw'emitwarize eyarikwebembera amahanga agarihoomeire omu bwire bw'Entaro Enyeenye; omu nkora egi, batebeekanize ebikorwa ebirikubaasa kukorwa. Omu mikurikiraano y'ebikorwa egi erikuzaaho, n'enki erikukwata abegi kushiija ekigyendererwa ekirikugambwaho?
answer_a:
1: Omu maapu y'ebyafaayo y'obwire bw'olutalo orw'obutiti, nibashanga embeera omu haraabeireho entaro ezitarikukora butoosha hagati y'amahanga againe amaani.

2: Baamara kuteeraniza hamwe, nibatoorana emwe aha ntaro ezo ezimanyirwe, reero bagyendeleza ekyahindwire omu by'obusiima n'eby'obuteegyeki.

3: Nibahanga omumeza ogurikuteeraniza entaro zoona hamwe, bagyendeleza ebyo amahanga againe amaani gaagyezireho kugyenda gagaruka.
answer_b:
1: Nibareeba nibareeba ebipande by'okuburira abantu ebyakozirwe Amerika na USSR, nibashushanisa embeera eyabireho, ekigyendererwa, n'ebindi.

2: Baheza bakwatana omu bibinja, baronda kimwe aha mahanga agiine amaani muno, baheza bakakora ekipande ekikirukiirira.

3: Nibatebeekanisiza okwohereza ebipande omu mutwe "USA vs USSR," okucweekamu kuraba omu kuronda erihanga eririine amaani muno.
answer_c:
1: Nibashwijuma ebitabo kuruga omu bitongore bikuru eby'obuhereza bw'amahanga goona (KGB na CIA), nibamanya emigasho yaabyo.

2: Nibagaita hamwe, nibakora ekishushani ekirikwooreka omu bwangu enshonga ezirikuhangwa ebitongore ebi byoona ahabw'emitwarize yaabyo y'okukora.

3: Nibakora akameeza k'okugyeragyeranisa aha mishinga ya politiika ei ebitongore by'obuhereza bw'amahanga goona birikugeza kwikiriza.
answer_d:
1: Nibarikiriza emikutu ya intaneeti nibashaka ebirikukwata aha miringo mikuru y'obuteezi y'amaani omu bwire bw'Entaro y'obutahoora.

2: Baamara kuteeranira hamwe, bashoma ebi barikushanga, barondera aha biteekateeko bikuru bya buri kimwe.

3: Nibarikwohereza ebi barikumaraho omu kiraasi, nibashohoza enshonga ezirikutaana n'ezirikushushana omu miringo eyakozirweho buri ihanga.

question: Omuhendo gwaha mirundi ki aha bibuuzo ebi ogurikukirayo kwebembera omucwekyerezo gw'omunda gw'ekishushani nk'enshuro y'ebyafaayo?

question: Omugurusi omu omuri eshomero erya haihi aha mu mwaka gwakabiri ali haihi kuhikiiriza omutwe ogurikugamba Kuruga omu nsi erimu emiringo ebiri okuhika omu nsi yoona. Ery'omutumbi. Nk'omurimo gw'okumaliriza, nibateekateeka kucungura, omu bindi ebintu, ekigyendererwa ekirikukurataho: "Kwetegyereza okukura kw'obushangwa bw'obuhunguzi." Ni birikurataho binga ebiri nibirekera omuntu kucungura okuhika kw'okwega kw'omwegi?
answer_a:
Nibarikiriza aha ndagaano eziri hagati y’ebibiina by’obufuzi kushinga obushoboorozi butaabaazibwe obwa gavumenti aha katale, ekyaraakwija kukwasa omu kwongyera oburingaaniza omu by’obuhangwa n’eby’obushomesha.

Nibateekateeka okukuratira amateeka agari ahansi g’obushomesha bw’obugagga gagamire kumalaho obutari buringaaniza omu by’obushomesha n’eby’obugagga.
answer_b:
Nibarikira omugasho gwa gavumenti omu kureeberera oburenganzira obukuru amakanisa g'obweineenya gatarikubaasa kureeberera obu obugabe bw'obushangwaire bukaba nibutandikwa omu Buraya.

Nibashoboorora okucuumuura okwakozirwe aha bugabe bw'obushangwaire aha nshonga z'eby'entaashe ezi bwateire omu Buraya, ekyareeteire obuzibu omu myaka ya 1970
answer_c:
Nibarikiriza engyenderwera z'okugyenda omuhanda gw'enteekanisa y'akatale n'okugabura obutungi bw'abantu nk'oku byateirweho omu Buraya kurabira omu gavumenti erikurora aha mbeera y'abantu.

Nibahakanisa obukuru bw'endagaano ahaagati ya gavumenti, abanyamurimo, n'ebirikwatiraine n'abakozi kutebeekanisa n'okukuumira embeera y'obuteerwa omu gavumenti erikurora aha mbeera y'abantu.
answer_d:
Nibarikiriza ebiranga by'obulemi bw'obugagga ekyashimweire omu by'ihanga rya Yuropo, nk'okutaho amateeka g'obuhangwa bw'abantu.

Nibashoboorora oku obulemi bw'obugagga ekyashimweire omu by'ihanga rya Yuropo kyataire omukago aha burenganzira bw'obuhangwa bw'abantu okukira oburenganzira bw'abantu n'obwa shena.

question: Omugyezibwa: Omusomesa, omu mutwe gw'ekigambo Enkomerero y'olutalo Orutaro, akatebeekanisiza abeeshuri be omumuhanda ogw'ekumi omurimo gw'okwega kwetegyereza ebyahandiikirwe eby'okubanza. Habw'ekyo, akabashomesa kandi abagarukamu ebibuzo kuruga omu kitabo ekyahandiikirwe omuntu kukwezirika: Entandikiro y'ekiteekerezo kya "perestroika" ekaba eri okwikiriza okurikukiraho ngu titurikubaasa kugumizamu kutuura nk'oku twabaire nitutuura. Ninkozesa okugamba aha kiri eki kandi tindikugeza kucwamu omurundi ogundi. Tindikweijuta, nangwa n'omumwanya, ngu ninkaba ndi entandikiro y'okukyusa okurikuhitsya omu bwomeezi bw'eihanga ryaitu. Ekyaijwire omu misho aha bwaire bwaitu obwahwereireho, ahabw'okusiimwa "glasnost," kikahamya omu muringo gw'obushariri n'obuteetegyereza ngu obutebeekanisa obutongoirwe kurugiirira aha miteekateeko y'obushariri n'obuteetegyereza tiburikubaasa kugumisirizibwa, tikurikurugiirira aha muringo gw'empisa, kureka kurugiirira aha muringo gw'ebyetengo by'omusingi by'eihanga omu by'obushubuzi n'eby'embeera z'abantu. Kikashuuruura eihanga aha muhanda ogutariho n'okuriteeka aha rubaju rw'ekihanga. Kandi kikagumizamu kubaho kuraba omu maani, ebishuba, okutiina, obuteetegyereza bw'abantu, hamwe n'obuhwezi bw'obujanjabi obw'obushuba obw'okusharabuura eby'obugaiga n'okugaramura amaani g'omumaisho. Okutemburwa kwa August. Amazima n'ebirikukurataho, Mikhail Gorbachev. Eki nikimwe aha bibuzo ebyagarukirwemu omweeshuri kurugiirira aha byahandiikirwe ebyo ahaiguru: Ni mugyenzi ki ogu embeera omu eyatebeekanisiibwemu amateeka ga Perestroika na Glasnost omu eyabaire USSR eine? Perestroika: okwikiriza ngu omuntu tarikubaasa kugumizamu kutuura omu muringo ogu baabaire nibatuuramu. Glasnost: n'obutebeekanisa obutongoirwe kurugiirira aha miteekateeko y'obushariri n'obuteetegyereza obutarikubaasa kugumisirizibwa. Ni bunafu ki oburikworeka omu kugarukamu kw'omweeshuri, aha bikwaata aha bushoboorozi bw'okwetegyereza ebyahandiikirwe?
answer_a: Ninkora ebirikuruga omu mazima kurugiirira aha biteekateeko byange.
answer_b: Eriyo ririkwata aha bintu ebirikworekwa obutahindurwa.
answer_c: Erihaba eky’okushoboorora ebi orikukurira omu nshuro yabyo otarikubaza ebibuuzo ebirikukwatana n’ebirikugambwaho.
answer_d: Ndyangirira eky'okushoboorora omuhandiiko ogurikugyenda gutarikwetegyereza eky'omuhandiiki arikwenda kumanyisa

question: Omwegyesereza, omuheereza omu, omu bwire bw'ekicweka ky'Entebeekanisa y'Amateeka n'Obwenegura, nayenda kumanya yaaba abegyi be omwaka gwa kana omuishomero rya haiguru nibetegyereza emirimo y'Eishomero ly'Abacwezi omu Chile. question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omu klasse y’ahaiguru ey’okushatu, omu mutwe gw’Eitaka, entebeekanisa, n’okwetaba omu by’omubyaro, bwanyima y’okugambira aha kigyendererwa eki: "Kwetegyereza embeera z’okurwanira eitaka orikurora omuhanda gw’oburingaaniza bw’abantu n’obutonde", akora omurimo gw’okushomesa orikwegamira aha kyetegyerezo eki: Omu itungo ryaitu, omu bwire bw’obutiti, amaka omu kitundu kya Porvenir nibatera kutaahwa amaizi g’omushana emirundi erukira omwe omwaka, ahabw’okuba tihariho miyoboro y’amaizi g’omushana, emiyoboro etera kuzibira ahabw’okubura okureeberera, kandi enganda zine obuterengo bwansi. Ekitundu kya Porvenir kine obugonza bw’abantu bwingi, ahabw’okuba ebicweka bingi by’amaka biri omu mbeera y’eby’obushoboorozi bw’emishaani y’ahaiguru. Okurwanira eitaka okurikubaho omu kitundu kya Porvenir nikukwatana n’oburingaaniza bw’abantu n’obutonde? Ahabw’enki? Ku araabeire naareeba okushomesa, omwegyesa naatunga eky’okugarukamu eki: Embeera omu kitundu kya Porvenir n’eky’okureeberaho ky’okubura entebeekanisa y’orurengo orungi n’amaani g’oburingaaniza bw’eby’obushoboorozi aha magara g’abantu. Kwonka, tikirikukwatana munonga n’oburingaaniza bw’abantu n’obutonde ahabw’okuba tiri buzibu bw’obutonde. Twashwijuma eky’okugarukamu eki, niki aha bintu ebi omwegyesa araakozese nk’okuhabura okurikuhiga omwegi kumanya enshobi ye?
answer_a: Ninkusiima kureeba oburemeezi bw'obutonde bw'ensi obw'ekicweka eki. Hati haroho omugasho gwona aha mbeera y'amagara g'abantu ogurikubaasa kuteekateekwa kuruga omu biteekateeko by'oburingaaniza bw'abantu n'obutonde bw'ensi?
answer_b: Kugumya okugumya ebi orikugamba, ndikukuhiga kushwijuma obuzibu obundi abantu b'omu kitundu kya Porvenir abarikuba nibarabana nabyo. Obuzibu obu nibubaasa kuba ensonga z'oburingaaniza bw'abantu n'obutonde bwabo?
answer_c: Ninkukugambira ngu orabe nooteekateeka aha bintu ebi: Mbwenu noobaasa kuteekateeka ngu ebintu ebi nibibaasa kuguza obuhunguzi bw'obutonde bw'ensi bw'ekicweka eki? Ku kiraabe nikwo kiri, tikiraabe nikiguza n'okutunga oburingaaniza bw'embeera z'obuntu n'obutonde bw'ensi bw'abantu abarikutuura omu kicweka ekyo?
answer_d: Eizo ebituura ebirikukwata oburemeezi bw'amaizi g'omugyera muno nibyo ebiri abakene muno, tikirikureeta amakuru ngu nibo abarikukwata oburemeezi obutariho aha bibiina by'abantu abandi? Eki nikikwatagana n'oburingaaniza bw'embeera z'obuntu n'obutonde?

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa kindagateni ateekateeka kushomesa ebigendererwa by'okwega ebiri ahansi y'ekicweka ky'okwetegyereza embeera z'obuhangwa n'obwahati: "Kubaza eby'obusingye ebikuru ebyabaireho omu itungo ryabo n'ihanga ryabo, nibakoresa ebintu nk'ebifaananyi, vidiyo, ebikoreso, nari ebintu ebirukirira." question: Ni omugyezibwa omu omuri ক্লাসে ya mukaaga, bwanyima y'okuganiira n'abeeshuri be aha bintu ebyareeteire oburemeezi bw'ekibuzo ky'embeera z'abantu omuri Chile, naija kucungura obushoboorozi bw'abeeshuri be okuhakanisa ebintu ebirikuruga omu nshuro ez'omutaano okucwamu ebirikukwata aha bintu by'omu byafaayo. Okukora eki, aha abeeshuri be ebyahandiikwa ebi okushoma: "Omuti gw'embeera egi y'obworooro nigushangwa omu makuru marungi, egaragiira abakungu kureeba aborooro nk'ab'eishe-emwe kandi bakafaayo aha mbeera yaabo kandi babataahira omu bwetaago, egaragiira aborooro omugisha gw'okushaba omu murimo ogurikwesigwa ebintu ebirikwetagisa okukuratira amagara." Ekyahindurwa kuruga owa Monsignor Mariano Casanova, Omukuru w'Eklesia ya Santiago (1891) "Enjigiriza y'okutafaayo neyikirizibwa. Twetaga kuteeka omu maani okutaahira omu kuteeraho embeera ensya eziija kutwijutsya kuruga omu mwanya ahu abantu abari ahansi nibeehurira nibarikushisha." Ekyahindurwa kuruga omu Ekibuzo ky'Embeera z'Abantu, A. Ortega (1884) "Obwire bukahiire abana b'omurimo boona, abagizire omukago omu itendeka, okwegaita hamwe omu mubiri gumwe kandi bakahanga amaani n'obushoboorozi bw'Eihanga. Iraale iitwe, abana b'abantu, nitukora nk'ebikoreso bibi byonka aha bashaija abaine zaabu." Ekyahindurwa kuruga owa Vicuñera, eiziina ry'ekicweka ky'omuhereza omu rupapura rw'amajanja Los ecos del Taller (1897) Ni ekibuuzo ki aha bibuuzo ebirikukurataho ekirikukiriza obuhame kukungaanizibwa ngu abeeshuri nibahakanisa enshuro okucwamu aha kibuzo ky'embeera z'abantu?
answer_a: Abahandiika bashatu nibagira bite aha bikorwa by'abakozi?
answer_b: Omwandiki omu omwe na omu agira busha obushabisho bw'okumaraho ekizibu ky'ekibuzo ky'embeera z'abantu?
answer_c: Oburemeezi ki bw'embeera y'eby'obushomesha n'eby'obugagga abuhandiiki bashaatu abu nibwo bakwataniiseho?
answer_d: Abahandiika bashatu nibakoresa omuringo ki ogurikushushana omu kubangaanisa embeera y'abakozi?

question: Omugyezibwa naayegyesa arikugyenda n'ekigyendererwa eki: "Shoboorora obukuru bw'okwegaita kw'abakazi omu magara g'abantu boona omu kyasha kya makumi abiri" n'abanyeshuri be ab'omukaaga. Eki, baryabuza abanyeshuri baabo kushwijuma ebyahandiikirwe eby'omu bwire bw'ahaire: Shoma ekyahandiikirwe eki: [. . .] Ntarwaniriire oburengane bw'okutoora abakazi, ahabw'okuba ndi omukazi orikukunda abakazi munonga, nari ahabw'okuba ndikwikiriza ngu abakazi nibarungi kukuraho abashaija nari ngu okutoora kw'abakazi nikwo kwonka kurikubaasa kucura ebizibu by'eihanga, kureka ahabw'okwikiriza kwanka. Ndi omwikiriza omu butegyeki bw'abantu, kurugiirira omu bantu, kandi ahabw'abantu. Nindikuteekateeka ngu abantu boona abarikutuura omu ihanga, n'obu baraabe bari abaraangi nari ab'amaraara, obunuuni nari obushaija, eby'obufuzi nari eby'ediini, baine oburengane bw'okugira obushoboorozi aha biro by'omu maisho by'ihanga ryabo.  Ebaruha kuruga ahari Elena Caffarena (Santiago, January 1949)  Kurugiirira aha kyahandiikirwe eki, bukuru ki obw'eby'obufuzi orukurana rw'abakazi nk'omukazi Elena Caffarena rwaagira omu kutunga oburengane bw'okutoora?  Ahabw'enki omurimo ogurikugambwaho omwegyesa guri kugyenda n'ekigyendererwa ky'eklassi twarikuteekateeka aha maani agatairwe aha bushoboorozi bw'abantu?
answer_a: Ahabw’okuba nikirikukiriza okuganiira n’okugira ebirowoozo eby’obusingye aha kwongyera abakazi omu kyasha kya makumi abiri.
answer_b: Ahabw’okuba nirukuzaho okwetegyereza okukuru kw’okurwanisa okwebemberwa abakazi omuri Chile
answer_c: Ahabw’okuba nigutwara aha kumanya n’okuteekateeka aha kimwe aha biragiro by’obweneguraasi ebi demokarasi ya Chile etungamiireho
answer_d: Ahabw’okuba nikigumya obureezi bw’okucwamu enshoro y’ebyahandiikwa kwetegyereza omuhendo gw’eby’okutoorana omu kyasha kya makumi abiri omuri Chile.

question: Omugyezibwa naija kwegyesa abegi b'ekicweka kya 7 omutwe ogurikukwata aha mahanga makuru agaabaho omu byafaayo by'abantu. Omu ishomo ry'okubanza, omwegyesa naija kwegyesa abegi oku toroora obuhame bw'ebirikukwata aha byafaayo, okubikoresa omu kwetegyereza obuhame obwo n'okuhiga okuteekateeka kw'eby'afaayo. Ni by'omumaiso ki abegi bashemereire kuba nibamanyire kubaasa kutorora obuhame bw'ebirikukwata aha byafaayo omu muringo ogurikusiima?
answer_a: Shobora ebika by'amashomo ebirimu omu izo eryo
answer_b: Manya abantu abakuru abarikwetwa omu nshuro egi.
answer_c: Shwijuma obuhangwa bw'ebirikukwata aha nshonga erikugambwaho.
answer_d: Shisha enshonga nkuru ezirikukwata aha muringo ogurikukoresibwa omu mahano agarikukwata aha muringo ogurikukoresibwa ogurikushangwa omu nshuro.

question: Omuhwezi w’ekicweka kya 7 omu ishomero, omu mutwe gw’Emyaka ya Hagati, omwegyesa ataho ekigyendererwa: "Kukuza okwetegyereza ebyafaayo kuraba omu kwetantara enkoragana z’ensalo hagati y’Abakristaayo, Abaisiraamu, n’Abayudaaya omu Kihangaale kya Iberian." Kutiisa eki, abuuza abegyi kwombeka orukurato orurikworeka enkoragana eziriyo omu bwire obwo. Obu arikukurira omurimo, areeba abegyi barikuremwa kumanya obuhangwa bw’enkoragana z’ensalo hagati y’Abaisiraamu, Abakristaayo, n’Abayudaaya. Nk’eky’okureeberaho, ashanga emirimo erimu ebiri nk’ebi: "Eiziina ryangye ni Muhamed, ndi Omwisiraamu omuto orikugyenda omu Bufuzi bw’Abaisiraamu obwa Cordoba, ab’eka yangye boona nibakurata ediini y’Obwisiraamu kandi nitutunda emikeeka omu katale. Titurikwegaita n’Abakristaayo nari Abayudaaya ahabw’okuba tibaine diini." Kurugiirira aha buhame obukoroirwe, murimo ki omusya omwegyesa arikubaasa kutebeekanisiza abegyi kutaaho ekigyendererwa ekitebeekanisiibwe, arikwesiimisa aha kukura kw’okwetegyereza ebyafaayo?
answer_a: Orikwenda omwe omwe, shoborra oku barikuteekateeka abantu abaabaire nibatuura omu kashenyi ka Iberian baabaire nibatuura hamwe n'oku baabaire nibakwatana, orikuruga omu kureeba ebishushani.
answer_b: Omu mirwi, mugaragaze emiringo etari emwe n'emwe y'okutuura hamwe eyaabaireho omuri Iberian Peninsula, murikire aha bi abantu ab'omuburyo bwona abaabaire bagituuramu baragaine.
answer_c: Yijuza ekicweka ekirikukwata aha nzikiriza z'abantu ababaire nibatuura omu kasiriira ka Iberian, orikugyenderera aha kusoma ekitabo ekirikukurabira omuhanda, orikushoboorora oku ezi nzikiriza zaabo zaagizire ngu zigume emikago yaabo
answer_d: Ha reebire eby'okureeberaho by'enkoragana eziriho hati omu bantu ab'Ekikristaayo n'Abaisiraamu kurugiirira omu by'okushoma amakuru aha intaneeti, orikwoleka okushushana n'obutashushana n'ekyabaireho omu Kihangaaro kya Iberia omu myaka yaakati.

question: Ni ki eki kuruga aha bikorwa ebi ekirikukuzaho obureezi bw'okucwamu ebiri omu nshuro abeeshuri?
answer_a: Baraaya omu izooba ry'ebyafaayo erimu eby'okuragyiirira ebintu n'ebishushani kuruga omu muco gw'Abazungu
answer_b: Nibatoraanisha ebishushani ebikwatanisa n'obuhangwa bw'eihanga omu bishushani by'amahanga agariho
answer_c: Nibarikiriza abimukira kuruga omu mahanga agari hamwe na hamwe, babereka abanywani baabo emico mikuru y'ebihanga ebyo.
answer_d: Nibarikora ebipanka ebiriho emiringo y'okwegamira emicwe y'abimukira kuruga omu bishushani ebirukiraine, hanyuma babiyerekane omu kiraasi.
